title: 現在簡單式與現在進行式
formula: V(s/es)　／　am・is・are + V-ing
points: 現在簡單式表習慣、事實、真理或時刻表，常搭配 always, usually, every day, on Sundays。
現在進行式表「說話當下」或「這陣子」正在進行的動作，常搭配 now, at the moment, Look!, Listen!。
know, like, want, love, have（擁有）等狀態動詞通常不用進行式。
高中會延伸到過去進行式、現在完成進行式，以及 when / while 引導的時間副詞子句。

examples.en: My brother plays basketball every Saturday.
examples.zh: 我弟弟每週六都打籃球。

examples.en: Be quiet! The baby is sleeping now.
examples.zh: 小聲點！寶寶現在正在睡覺。

examples.en: Water boils at 100 degrees Celsius.
examples.zh: 水在攝氏一百度沸騰。

tip: 狀態動詞不用進行式：I am knowing the answer. → I know the answer.

qs.s: Mia usually ______ to school by bike.
qs.ex: usually 表習慣，主詞 Mia 是第三人稱單數，動詞用 rides。

qs.s: Listen! Someone ______ the piano in the music room.
qs.ex: Listen! 提示動作正在進行，用 is playing。

qs.s: I ______ the answer to this question.
qs.ex: know 是狀態動詞，不用進行式；主詞 I 搭配 know。

qs.s: The sun ______ in the east and sets in the west.
qs.ex: 自然現象屬於事實，用現在簡單式，主詞 The sun 為單數，用 rises。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: He is go to the library every day.
He going to the library every day.
He goes to the library every day.
He go to the library every day.
qs.ex: every day 表習慣，主詞 He 要用 goes；is go 和 going 都沒有正確的動詞形式，go 少了 -es。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: I am wanting a new bike for my birthday.
I wants a new bike for my birthday.
I am want a new bike for my birthday.
I want a new bike for my birthday.
qs.ex: want 是狀態動詞，不用進行式；主詞 I 時 want 不加 s。

title: 過去式與現在完成式
formula: V-ed（過去）　／　have・has + p.p.
points: 過去簡單式用於已結束的過去時間，常搭配 yesterday, last week, in 2020, two days ago。
現在完成式連結過去與現在：經驗（ever, never, before）、完成（already, yet, just）、持續（for, since）。
現在完成式不能和明確的過去時間（yesterday, last year, ago）連用。
高中會延伸到過去完成式 had + p.p. 與現在完成進行式 have been V-ing。

examples.en: We visited the science museum last month.
examples.zh: 我們上個月參觀了科學博物館。

examples.en: I have lived in this town for ten years.
examples.zh: 我在這個鎮上住了十年。

examples.en: Have you ever tried Taiwanese shaved ice?
examples.zh: 你吃過台灣的剉冰嗎？

tip: I have seen him yesterday. → I saw him yesterday.（有 yesterday 就用過去式）

qs.s: Ken ______ in Taipei since he was a baby.
qs.ex: since 引導「從過去到現在」的持續，主要子句用現在完成式 has lived。

qs.s: We ______ the movie yesterday, and it was great.
qs.ex: yesterday 是明確的過去時間，用過去式 saw。

qs.s: Tina hasn't finished her homework ______.
qs.ex: 現在完成式的否定句句尾常搭配 yet；其他選項是明確的過去時間。

qs.s: How long have you ______ this phone?
qs.ex: have + p.p.，have 的過去分詞是 had。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: She has lost her key last night.
She has lose her key last night.
She lost her key last night.
She losing her key last night.
qs.ex: last night 是明確的過去時間，要用過去式 lost，不能用現在完成式。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: I have known Amy since five years.
I have known Amy for five years.
I knew Amy for five years now.
I know Amy for five years.
qs.ex: for + 一段時間，搭配現在完成式；since 後面要接起點時間，不是一段時間。

title: 未來式 will 與 be going to
formula: will + VR　／　am・is・are going to + VR
points: will 表臨時決定、預測或承諾；be going to 表事先已有的計畫，或根據現在跡象判斷即將發生。
will 後面接原形動詞，所有主詞都用 will；be going to 的 be 要依主詞變化。
兩者後面的動詞都用原形，不能加 -s、-ing 或 to。
高中會延伸到「時間／條件副詞子句用現在式代替未來式」，如 When he arrives, I will call you.

examples.en: I am going to visit my grandparents this weekend.
examples.zh: 我這個週末打算去探望祖父母。

examples.en: The phone is ringing. I will answer it.
examples.zh: 電話在響，我來接。

examples.en: Look at the dark clouds. It is going to rain soon.
examples.zh: 看那些烏雲，快要下雨了。

tip: He will goes to school. → He will go to school.（will 後接原形）

qs.s: Dad says he ______ us to the zoo next Sunday.
qs.ex: will 與 be going to 後面都接原形動詞；will takes 和 going to takes 都錯了。

qs.s: A: This bag is too heavy for me.　B: Don't worry. I ______ help you.
qs.ex: 臨時決定幫忙用 will + 原形；其他選項無法與 help 組成正確的未來式。

qs.s: Are you ______ join the school trip next month?
qs.ex: Are you going to + VR 是計畫的問法；will 後面不加 to。

qs.s: According to the weather report, tomorrow ______ a sunny day.
qs.ex: will + be 表預測；going to be 缺少 be 動詞，is going 缺少 to be。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: She will to go to the party tonight.
She will goes to the party tonight.
She will go to the party tonight.
She will going to the party tonight.
qs.ex: will 後面直接接原形動詞 go，不加 to，也不加 -es 或 -ing。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: We are going to has a picnic on Sunday.
We going to have a picnic on Sunday.
We will to have a picnic on Sunday.
We are going to have a picnic on Sunday.
qs.ex: be going to 後接原形 have；going to 前面不能漏掉 be 動詞。

title: 被動語態
formula: be + p.p.（+ by + 動作者）
points: 主詞是動作的承受者時用被動語態；動作者不重要或不明時，by + 動作者可以省略。
be 動詞依時態變化：is made, was built, will be held, has been done, must be finished。
不及物動詞（happen, arrive, die, rise）不能用被動語態。
高中會延伸到 get + p.p.、過去分詞片語（Built in 1998, the bridge …）與 be said to V 等句型。

examples.en: This bridge was built in 1998.
examples.zh: 這座橋是在一九九八年蓋的。

examples.en: English is spoken in many countries.
examples.zh: 許多國家說英語。

examples.en: The school festival will be held next month.
examples.zh: 校慶將在下個月舉行。

tip: The accident was happened last night. → The accident happened last night.

qs.s: The windows ______ by the students every Friday.
qs.ex: 窗戶是被清理的對象，用被動語態 are cleaned。

qs.s: The movie ______ by a famous Taiwanese director last year.
qs.ex: last year 表過去，被動語態用 was + 過去分詞 directed。

qs.s: A strange thing ______ to me on my way home.
qs.ex: happen 是不及物動詞，不能用被動語態，用 happened。

qs.s: The homework must ______ before Monday.
qs.ex: 助動詞 must 後接被動 be + p.p.，作業是「被完成」。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: The cake was eat by my brother.
The cake was ate by my brother.
The cake was eaten by my brother.
qs.ex: 被動語態要用 be + 過去分詞，eat 的過去分詞是 eaten。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: The letter will be sent tomorrow.
The letter will be send tomorrow.
The letter is will be sent tomorrow.
qs.ex: will be + p.p. 是未來被動；其他選項缺 be、用錯分詞或多了 is。

title: 比較級與最高級
formula: 比較級 + than　／　the + 最高級 (+ of / in)
points: 一音節字尾加 -er / -est（tall → taller → tallest）；子音 + y 改 -ier / -iest；兩音節以上多用 more / most。
不規則變化：good → better → best，bad → worse → worst，many / much → more → most。
比較級前可用 much, a lot, even, far 加強，不可用 very；最高級前要加 the，後面用 of + 複數 或 in + 範圍。
高中會延伸到 the + 比較級, the + 比較級，以及 twice as … as 等倍數比較。

examples.en: This math test was harder than the last one.
examples.zh: 這次數學考試比上一次難。

examples.en: Of all my friends, Amy is the most helpful.
examples.zh: 在我所有朋友中，艾咪最樂於助人。

examples.en: My new phone is much lighter than my old one.
examples.zh: 我的新手機比舊的輕多了。

tip: He is more taller than me. → He is taller than me.（不可雙重比較）；very taller → much taller

qs.s: Taipei 101 is ______ than any other building in Taiwan.
qs.ex: 後面有 than，用比較級 taller。

qs.s: Mina is the ______ student in our class.
qs.ex: the 加上最高級；smart 是一音節，最高級為 smartest。

qs.s: This restaurant is ______ more expensive than that one.
qs.ex: 加強比較級用 much，不可用 very, so, too。

qs.s: My cooking is getting ______. I made a perfect cake today.
qs.ex: get + 比較級表示「越來越…」，good 的比較級是 better。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: He is more taller than his father.
He is the taller than his father.
He is tall than his father.
He is taller than his father.
qs.ex: than 前面用比較級 taller；more taller 是雙重比較，the 不能和 than 連用。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: This is the more interesting book I have ever read.
This is the most interesting book I have ever read.
This is most interesting book I have ever read.
This is the interestingest book I have ever read.
qs.ex: 表示「最…」用 the most + 多音節形容詞；interesting 不加 -est。

title: 不定詞 to V 與動名詞 V-ing
formula: enjoy・finish・mind + V-ing　／　want・hope・decide + to V
points: 只接動名詞的動詞：enjoy, finish, mind, avoid, practice, keep, give up, consider。
只接不定詞的動詞：want, hope, decide, plan, learn, promise, agree, refuse, would like。
like, love, start, begin 兩者都可以；介系詞後面一律用 V-ing（be good at, look forward to, thank you for）。
高中會延伸到 forget / remember / stop + to V 與 + V-ing 意思不同。

examples.en: She enjoys reading comic books after school.
examples.zh: 她喜歡在放學後看漫畫。

examples.en: We decided to take the early train.
examples.zh: 我們決定搭早班火車。

examples.en: Thank you for helping me with my homework.
examples.zh: 謝謝你幫我做功課。

tip: I enjoy to swim. → I enjoy swimming.　I look forward to see you. → …to seeing you.

qs.s: Would you mind ______ the door for me?
qs.ex: mind 後面接動名詞，用 opening。

qs.s: Jack hopes ______ a doctor in the future.
qs.ex: hope 後面接不定詞 to + VR。

qs.s: The students practiced ______ the song for two hours.
qs.ex: practice 後面接動名詞 singing。

qs.s: I'm looking forward to ______ you again soon.
qs.ex: look forward to 的 to 是介系詞，後面接 V-ing。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: He refused to answer the question.
qs.ex: refuse 後面接不定詞 to V。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: She is good at to play tennis.
She is good at play tennis.
She is good at playing tennis.
She is good at played tennis.
qs.ex: be good at 的 at 是介系詞，後面接 V-ing。

title: 使役動詞 make / let / have
formula: make・let・have + O + VR
points: make 表「強迫、使」，let 表「讓、允許」，have 表「請、叫（某人做）」。
受詞後面接原形動詞，不加 to，也不加 -ing。
get + O + to V 的意思近似 have，但後面要加 to。
高中會延伸到被動 be made to V，以及 have / get + O + p.p.（have my hair cut）。

examples.en: The teacher made us clean the classroom.
examples.zh: 老師要我們打掃教室。

examples.en: My parents let me stay up late on weekends.
examples.zh: 我父母週末讓我熬夜。

examples.en: I will have my brother fix my bike.
examples.zh: 我會叫我哥哥修我的腳踏車。

tip: The story made me to cry. → The story made me cry.（make 的主動句不加 to）

qs.s: The sad movie made everyone ______.
qs.ex: make + O + VR，用原形 cry。

qs.s: Mom doesn't let my little sister ______ too much candy.
qs.ex: let + O + VR，所以用 eat。

qs.s: I'll have the waiter ______ you a menu.
qs.ex: have + O + VR，用原形 bring。

qs.s: Please let me ______ you with the bags.
qs.ex: let + O + VR，用原形 help。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: My boss made him to work late.
My boss made him work late.
My boss made him working late.
My boss made him worked late.
qs.ex: make + O + VR，work 前不加 to，也不用 -ing 或過去式。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: The teacher let us to leave early.
The teacher let us leaving early.
The teacher let us left early.
The teacher let us leave early.
qs.ex: let + O + VR，用原形 leave。

title: 感官動詞與連綴動詞
formula: see・hear・watch・feel + O + VR / V-ing　；　look・sound・smell + adj.
points: 感官動詞後接「受詞 + 原形動詞」表看到／聽到事情的全部經過；接 V-ing 表動作正在進行。
感官動詞後面的原形動詞不加 to。
look, sound, smell, taste, feel 當「看起來、聽起來…」時是連綴動詞，後面接形容詞，不接副詞。
高中會延伸到 see + O + p.p.（被動）以及被動語態 be seen to V。

examples.en: I saw a boy cross the street by himself.
examples.zh: 我看見一個男孩自己過馬路。

examples.en: We heard someone singing in the next room.
examples.zh: 我們聽到隔壁房間有人在唱歌。

examples.en: This soup smells delicious.
examples.zh: 這碗湯聞起來很香。

tip: I heard her to cry. → I heard her cry.　The soup smells well. → The soup smells good.

qs.s: Tom watched the birds ______ in the sky.
qs.ex: watch + O + VR，用原形 fly。

qs.s: I felt something ______ up my arm, so I jumped.
qs.ex: 感官動詞 + O + V-ing 表動作正在進行，用 crawling。

qs.s: The cake smells ______.
qs.ex: smell 是連綴動詞，後面接形容詞 sweet。

qs.s: We heard the old man ______ a story to the children.
qs.ex: hear + O + V-ing，聽到他正在說故事。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: I saw her to enter the room.
I saw she enter the room.
I saw her entered the room.
I saw her enter the room.
qs.ex: see + 受格 + 原形動詞；不加 to，受詞要用 her，也不用過去式。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
qs.ex: sound 是連綴動詞，後面接形容詞 good，不接副詞。

title: 關係代名詞（限定用法）
formula: N + who / which / that + V
points: who 指人，which 指物，that 人與物都可以；關係代名詞引導的子句用來修飾前面的名詞。
關代當主詞時，後面直接接動詞，動詞單複數與先行詞一致；不可再重複放代名詞。
關代當受詞時可以省略（the book (that) I bought）。
高中會延伸到非限定用法（加逗號、不用 that）、whose、介系詞 + 關代，以及省略後變成分詞片語。

examples.en: The girl who sits next to me is my cousin.
examples.zh: 坐在我旁邊的女孩是我的表姊。

examples.en: I like the shoes that you wore yesterday.
examples.zh: 我喜歡你昨天穿的鞋子。

examples.en: This is the book which helped me a lot.
examples.zh: 這是幫了我很多的那本書。

tip: The man who he lives next door is a nurse. → The man who lives next door is a nurse.（who 已是主詞，不加 he）

qs.s: The boy ______ is standing there is my classmate.
qs.ex: 先行詞是人，關代當主詞，用 who。

qs.s: I lost the pen ______ my grandfather gave me.
qs.ex: 先行詞是物，用 that（或 which）引導形容詞子句。

qs.s: The students ______ study hard usually get good grades.
qs.ex: 先行詞是 students（人），主詞關代用 who。

qs.s: A dictionary is a book ______ tells you the meaning of words.
qs.ex: 先行詞是物，關代當主詞用 that；who 指人，it 不是關代。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: The woman who teaches us English she is very kind.
The woman who teaches us English is very kind.
The woman which teaches us English is very kind.
The woman who teach us English is very kind.
qs.ex: 先行詞是人用 who；who 已是主詞，不重複 she，動詞 teaches 也要與單數 woman 一致。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: This is the cake who my mom made.
This is the cake what my mom made.
This is the cake that my mom made.
This is the cake it my mom made.
qs.ex: 先行詞是物，用 that 或 which；who 指人，what 不能修飾名詞，it 不是關代。

title: 連接詞 because / although / so / but
formula: because ... / although ... / so ... / so + adj + that ...
points: because 表原因，so 表結果；兩者不能同時出現在同一句（Because ..., so ... 是錯的）。
although / though 表「雖然」，不能和 but 連用；中文「雖然…但是…」在英文只能擇一。
so + adj / adv + that 子句表「如此…以致於」；such + (a) + adj + 名詞 + that 子句。
高中會延伸到 so that 表目的、not only ... but also、whereas 與對等連接詞的用法。

examples.en: We stayed home because it was raining heavily.
examples.zh: 因為下大雨，所以我們待在家。

examples.en: Although he was tired, he finished the report.
examples.zh: 雖然他累了，他還是完成了報告。

examples.en: The soup was so hot that I couldn't drink it.
examples.zh: 這碗湯太燙了，我沒辦法喝。

tip: Because it rained, so we stayed home. → 只留一個；Although he is young, but he is smart. → 刪掉 but

qs.s: ______ Ella studied hard, she failed the test.
qs.ex: 前後語意相反，用 Although 表「雖然」。

qs.s: I was ______ tired that I fell asleep on the bus.
qs.ex: so + adj + that 表「如此…以致於」；such 後面要接名詞。

qs.s: We couldn't go hiking ______ the heavy rain.
qs.ex: 後面是名詞片語 the heavy rain，要用 because of。

qs.s: It was ______ a good movie that we watched it twice.
qs.ex: a good movie 是名詞片語，用 such a + adj + N + that。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: Because he was sick, so he stayed in bed.
Because of he was sick, he stayed in bed.
Because he was sick, but he stayed in bed.
Because he was sick, he stayed in bed.
qs.ex: Because 與 so 不能同時使用；because of 後面接名詞，不接子句；原因與結果不是轉折，不用 but。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: Although the test was hard, but I passed it.
Although the test was hard, so I passed it.
Although the test hard, I passed it.
Although the test was hard, I passed it.
qs.ex: Although 不與 but 或 so 連用；子句也需要 was。

title: 附加問句
formula: 肯定句, 否定附加問句？　／　否定句, 肯定附加問句？
points: 前面是肯定句，附加問句用否定縮寫；前面是否定句，附加問句用肯定。
附加問句的助動詞依前句決定：be 動詞、助動詞照用，一般動詞依時態用 do / does / did；主詞要換成代名詞。
特殊形式：I am → aren't I?；Let's → shall we?；祈使句 → will you?；there is → isn't there?
高中的對話題與綜合測驗常用附加問句確認語氣，要熟悉各種助動詞。

examples.en: You like pizza, don't you?
examples.zh: 你喜歡披薩，對不對？

examples.en: Your sister can't swim, can she?
examples.zh: 你姊姊不會游泳，對嗎？

examples.en: Let's go to the park, shall we?
examples.zh: 我們去公園好嗎？

tip: She is smart, doesn't she? → She is smart, isn't she?（要依前面的動詞決定）

qs.s: Tom finished his homework, ______?
qs.ex: 前句是肯定的過去式，附加問句用否定 didn't he。

qs.s: You aren't busy now, ______?
qs.ex: 前句是否定，附加問句用肯定；動詞是 be，所以用 are you。

qs.s: Open the window, ______?
qs.ex: 祈使句的附加問句用 will you。

qs.s: I am your best friend, ______?
qs.ex: I am 的附加問句特殊，用 aren't I。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
qs.ex: 前句是肯定，後面用否定；助動詞 can 要保留，用 can't she。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: They don't like math, don't they?
They don't like math, are they?
They don't like math, did they?
They don't like math, do they?
qs.ex: 前句是否定現在式，附加問句用肯定 do they。

title: 間接問句
formula: wh- + S + V（不倒裝）
points: 問句放在另一個句子中，要改成直述句語序：wh- + 主詞 + 動詞，不再倒裝，也不加 do / does / did。
Where does he live? → I know where he lives.（動詞形式要隨主詞與時態調整）
yes / no 問句改成 if 或 whether 引導：Do you know if he is at home?
高中會延伸到 wh- 名詞子句當主詞、受詞、補語（What he said surprised me.）。

examples.en: I don't know where she bought this bag.
examples.zh: 我不知道她在哪裡買這個包包。

examples.en: Can you tell me what time the movie starts?
examples.zh: 你可以告訴我電影幾點開始嗎？

examples.en: Do you know if the library is open today?
examples.zh: 你知道圖書館今天有沒有開嗎？

tip: I don't know where is he. → I don't know where he is.

qs.s: Could you tell me where ______?
qs.ex: 間接問句不倒裝，語序是 where + 主詞 + 動詞。

qs.s: I wonder what ______ for lunch.
qs.ex: 間接問句用直述句語序，主詞 she 後接 wants，不加 does。

qs.s: I can't tell ______ it will rain tomorrow or not.
qs.ex: yes / no 的間接問句用 whether（或 if）；其他疑問詞語意不合。

qs.s: Do you remember how many students ______ in your class?
qs.ex: 間接問句不倒裝，用 there are，不用 are there。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: I don't know what is her name.
I don't know what her name is.
I don't know what does her name is.
I don't know what her name.
qs.ex: 間接問句的語序是 what + 主詞 + 動詞：what her name is。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: Do you know when does the bus come?
Do you know when the bus does come?
Do you know when the bus comes?
Do you know when the bus coming?
qs.ex: 間接問句中不能再加 does，動詞用 comes。

title: 情緒形容詞 -ing 與 -ed
formula: V-ing（令人…的）　／　V-ed（感到…的）
points: -ing 形容詞說明事物的特性，表「令人感到…」：The movie is boring.
-ed 形容詞說明人的感受，表「感到…」：I am bored.
常見成對字：interesting / interested, boring / bored, exciting / excited, tiring / tired, surprising / surprised, confusing / confused。
高中會延伸到現在分詞與過去分詞的分詞片語（Excited by the news, she jumped for joy.）。

examples.en: The movie was so boring that I almost fell asleep.
examples.zh: 那部電影太無聊了，我差點睡著。

examples.en: I am interested in space travel.
examples.zh: 我對太空旅行很有興趣。

examples.en: The surprised students looked at the strange box.
examples.zh: 驚訝的學生們看著那個奇怪的盒子。

tip: I am boring. → I am bored.（I am boring 是「我這個人很無聊」）

qs.s: The roller coaster was really ______.
qs.ex: 主詞是事物，表「令人興奮的」，用 exciting。

qs.s: Lily felt ______ about the trip.
qs.ex: 主詞是人，表「感到興奮」，用 excited。

qs.s: The science show was ______, so all the kids watched it carefully.
qs.ex: 節目讓人感興趣，用 interesting。

qs.s: I was ______ by the difficult math problem.
qs.ex: 人感到困惑，用 confused。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: My father was tiring after work.
My father was tired after work.
My father was tire after work.
My father was tiredly after work.
qs.ex: 人感到疲倦，用 tired；tiring 表「使人疲累的」。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: I am very interesting in this book.
qs.ex: 書是令人感興趣的，用 interesting；人才用 interested，且要說 be interested in。

title: 可數與不可數名詞及數量詞
formula: many / a few / few + 複數　；　much / a little / little + 不可數
points: 可數名詞有單複數；不可數名詞（water, milk, money, advice, homework, news, furniture）不加 -s，也不加 a / an，動詞用單數。
many, a few, few 接可數複數；much, a little, little 接不可數；a lot of 兩者皆可。
a few / a little 表「一些」；few / little 表「幾乎沒有」，語氣偏否定。
不可數名詞用 a piece of, a cup of, a bottle of 計算。高中會延伸到 the number of / a number of 等動詞一致問題。

examples.en: There are a few chairs in the room.
examples.zh: 房間裡有幾張椅子。

examples.en: I don't have much time this afternoon.
examples.zh: 我今天下午沒有很多時間。

examples.en: She gave me a piece of useful advice.
examples.zh: 她給了我一個有用的建議。

tip: informations, advices, homeworks 都錯；a few water → a little water

qs.s: How ______ money do you need for the trip?
qs.ex: money 是不可數名詞，問數量用 how much。

qs.s: There are ______ students in the library, so it is quiet.
qs.ex: students 是可數複數，few 表「幾乎沒有」，符合很安靜的語意。

qs.s: The teacher gave us a lot of ______ today.
qs.ex: homework 是不可數名詞，不加 s，也不加 a。

qs.s: Could I have ______ milk in my tea, please?
qs.ex: milk 不可數，「一點點」用 a little。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: She gave me many good advices.
She gave me a lot of good advice.
She gave me a good advices.
She gave me much good advices.
qs.ex: advice 是不可數名詞，不加 s，可用 a lot of 修飾。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: There is a few water in the bottle.
I need a little help with this problem.
How many time do you have?
qs.ex: help 是不可數，a little help 正確；news 視為單數，water 用 a little，time 不可數要用 how much。

title: if 條件句（真實條件）
formula: If + 現在式, S + will + VR
points: 表示未來有可能發生的事：if 子句用現在簡單式，不可用 will。
主要子句常用 will + VR，也可用 can, may 或祈使句。
unless = if ... not：You will be late unless you hurry up. = If you don't hurry up, ...
高中會延伸到與現在事實相反的假設語氣（If I were you, I would …）及 if 與 whether 的差別。

examples.en: If it rains tomorrow, we will stay at home.
examples.zh: 如果明天下雨，我們就待在家。

examples.en: If you study hard, you can pass the exam.
examples.zh: 如果你用功讀書，就能通過考試。

examples.en: You will be late unless you hurry up.
examples.zh: 你如果不快點就會遲到。

tip: If it will rain tomorrow, ... → If it rains tomorrow, ...；unless 已含否定，不再加 not

qs.s: If the weather ______ good tomorrow, we will go camping.
qs.ex: if 子句表未來，用現在式 is，不用 will be。

qs.s: If you ______ me your email, I will send you the photos.
qs.ex: if 子句用現在簡單式 tell。

qs.s: You won't pass the test ______ you study harder.
qs.ex: unless 表「除非」，等於 if you don't study harder。

qs.s: If Sam ______ late again, the teacher will be angry.
qs.ex: if 子句用現在式，Sam 是第三人稱單數，用 comes。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: If I will have time, I will help you.
If I have time, I will help you.
If I have time, I help will you.
If I had time, I will help you.
qs.ex: if 子句不用 will，主要子句用 will + VR；其餘選項時態或語序有誤。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: If it is sunny tomorrow, we going to the beach.
Unless you don't hurry, you will miss the bus.
If you will help me, I will be happy.
If you leave now, you will catch the bus.
qs.ex: if 子句用現在式，主要句用 will；其他選項分別缺少助動詞、unless 後多了 not、if 子句用 will。

title: too ... to 與 enough to
formula: too + adj + to V　／　adj + enough + to V
points: too + adj + to V 表「太…而不能…」，本身已有否定意義，不再加 not。
adj / adv + enough + to V 表「夠…可以…」；enough 放在形容詞或副詞後面（old enough），修飾名詞時放前面（enough money）。
要說出做事的人時，用 for + 受詞：too heavy for me to carry。
高中會延伸到 so ... that / such ... that，以及 in order to / so as to 表目的。

examples.en: The box is too heavy for me to carry.
examples.zh: 這個箱子太重，我搬不動。
hl: too heavy for me to carry

examples.en: She is old enough to travel by herself.
examples.zh: 她夠大了，可以自己旅行。

examples.en: It was too late to catch the last train.
examples.zh: 太晚了，趕不上末班車。

tip: He is too tired to not walk. → He is too tired to walk.；enough old → old enough

qs.s: The soup is ______ hot to drink right now.
qs.ex: too + adj + to V 表「太…而不能」；其他選項無法搭配 to drink。

qs.s: Mark is tall ______ to reach the top shelf.
qs.ex: adj + enough + to V 表「夠…可以」，enough 放在形容詞 tall 後面。

qs.s: The question was too difficult ______ answer.
qs.ex: too + adj + for + 受格 + to V；受格是 me，且前面要有 for。

qs.s: We don't have ______ money to buy a new car.
qs.ex: enough + 名詞 + to V 表「足夠的…可以…」。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: He is too young to not drive a car.
He is too young for drive a car.
He is too young to drive a car.
He is young too to drive a car.
qs.ex: too ... to V 本身已含否定，不加 not，to 後直接接原形動詞，too 放在形容詞前。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: The room is enough big to hold fifty people.
The room is big enough to hold fifty people.
The room is big enough holding fifty people.
The room is big enough hold fifty people.
qs.ex: enough 放在形容詞後面，後接 to + 原形動詞。

title: that 引導的名詞子句
formula: S + V + that + S + V
points: that 引導名詞子句，在句中當 think、know、find、realize 等動詞的受詞。
形容詞（glad, sure, afraid, worried）後面也可接 that 子句，說明情緒或判斷的內容。
that 本身沒有意義，也不是子句的成分；that 之後必須是完整的「主詞＋動詞」。
作受詞時 that 常可省略，但保留會讓句子結構更清楚。

examples.en: My teacher says that we should read more English stories.
examples.zh: 我的老師說我們應該多讀英文故事。
hl: that we should read more English stories

examples.en: I am glad that you can join our school trip.
examples.zh: 你能參加我們的校外教學，我很高興。
hl: that you can join our school trip

examples.en: We soon found that the lake was too cold for swimming.
examples.zh: 我們很快發現湖水冷得不能游泳。
hl: that the lake was too cold for swimming

tip: that 之後要接完整子句；若子句缺少主詞或受詞才用 what。✗ I know that he wants. ✓ I know that he wants it. / I know what he wants.

qs.s: Mia was surprised ______ her brother had cooked dinner for the whole family.
qs.ex: surprised 後接完整子句說明驚訝的內容，用 that 引導；what、which、where 都不適合連接這個完整子句。

qs.s: The doctor told us ______ we should drink more water in hot weather.
qs.ex: told us 後面要接完整的名詞子句，用 that 引導；子句內 drink 已有受詞 water，不能用 what。

qs.s: I believe ______ honesty is the best policy in any friendship.
qs.ex: believe 後接 that 名詞子句；honesty is the best policy 是完整句，不需要 what 或 how。

qs.s: It is clear ______ the team needs more time to practice before the contest.
qs.ex: 形容詞 clear 後面的內容是完整子句，用 that 引導。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: She hopes what her son will pass the exam.
He said that he was too tired to join us.
I am sure that to win the game.
It is true what he can sing well.
qs.ex: B 的 that 後面接完整子句。A 不能用 what；C 的 that 後面不能接不定詞；D 應該用 that 而不是 what。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: I'm afraid of that I will be late.
I'm afraid that will I be late.
I'm afraid what I will be late.
I'm afraid that I will be late.
qs.ex: 名詞子句不倒裝，且 afraid 後直接接 that，不加 of；what 也不能引導完整子句。

title: 虛主詞 It 與不定詞片語
formula: It + be + adj + (for/of + O) + to V
points: 當主詞是一長串的不定詞片語時，常用虛主詞 it 放句首，真正的主詞 to V 放句尾。
for + 受詞 表示動作的執行者，放在形容詞與 to V 之間。
形容詞若描述人的個性或品行（kind, nice, rude, polite, careless），要用 of，而不是 for。
描述事情難易、重要、必要（easy, hard, necessary, important）的形容詞，則搭配 for。

examples.en: It is important for students to get enough sleep.
examples.zh: 學生獲得足夠的睡眠很重要。
hl: It is important for students to get

examples.en: It was kind of the stranger to show us the way.
examples.zh: 那位陌生人好心地為我們指路。
hl: It was kind of the stranger to show

examples.en: It is not easy to learn a new language in a month.
examples.zh: 一個月內學會一種新語言並不容易。
hl: It is not easy to learn

tip: 形容詞描述人的品格用 of，描述事情用 for。✗ It is kind for you to help. ✓ It is kind of you to help.

qs.s: It is not easy ______ a good habit in just one week.
qs.ex: It is + adj + to V，真主詞用不定詞 to build。

qs.s: It is necessary ______ all students to wear helmets when riding bikes.
qs.ex: necessary 描述事情的必要性，動作執行者前用 for。

qs.s: It was very polite ______ Tom to give his seat to the old lady.
qs.ex: polite 是描述人品行的形容詞，故用 of Tom。

qs.s: ______ is difficult for me to wake up before six o'clock.
qs.ex: 空格要放虛主詞 it，真主詞是後面的 to wake up。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: It is hard for me understand this poem.
Is hard for me to understand this poem.
It is hard for me to understand this poem.
It is hard of me to understand this poem.
qs.ex: A 缺少 to；B 缺少虛主詞 It；D 的 hard 描述事情難易，應用 for 而非 of。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: It is nice for you bring me lunch.
It is nice of you bring me lunch.
It is nice you of to bring me lunch.
It is nice of you to bring me lunch.
qs.ex: 稱讚人的形容詞（nice、kind）用 It is + adj. + of + 人 + to V；to 不可省略，for 也不能用在這裡。

title: 間接問句
formula: S + V + wh-word + S + V
points: 把疑問句放進另一個句子中，就成為間接問句，在句中當名詞子句（常作受詞）。
間接問句要用「疑問詞＋主詞＋動詞」的肯定句語序，不倒裝，也不再加 do/does/did。
沒有疑問詞的 Yes/No 問句，要改用 if 或 whether 引導。
原本的 did 拿掉後，動詞要還原成過去式：What did he say? → I know what he said.

examples.en: Do you know where the school library is?
examples.zh: 你知道學校圖書館在哪裡嗎？

examples.en: I can't remember what time the movie starts.
examples.zh: 我不記得電影幾點開始。

examples.en: Please tell me whether you will come to the party.
examples.zh: 請告訴我你是否會來派對。

tip: ✗ I don't know where is the post office. ✓ I don't know where the post office is. 也別加助動詞：✗ Do you know what did he say? ✓ Do you know what he said?

qs.s: Can you tell me ______ the nearest bookstore is?
qs.ex: 間接問句語序為「疑問詞＋主詞＋動詞」，所以是 where the nearest bookstore is。

qs.s: Nobody knows why ______ the meeting yesterday.
qs.ex: 間接問句不加助動詞 did，動詞改回過去式 missed。

qs.s: Do you know ______ the museum opens on Mondays?
qs.ex: 原問句是 Yes/No 問句，應用 whether 引導，意思是「是否」。

qs.s: Let me ask him how many books ______ to the library.
qs.ex: how many books 之後接主詞＋動詞，用過去式 he returned，不倒裝。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: I wonder how much does this jacket cost.
Tell me what do you want for lunch.
She asked me where I had bought the bag.
Do you know who is that girl?
qs.ex: C 語序正確。A、B、D 都把疑問句的倒裝或助動詞帶進了名詞子句。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: Could you tell me when does the train leave?
Could you tell me when the train leaves?
Could you tell me when did the train leave?
Could you tell me when leaves the train?
qs.ex: 間接問句要把 the train leaves 放在 when 之後，不倒裝、不用 does/did。

title: 關係代名詞與形容詞子句
formula: N + who/which/that + V；N, who/which + V
points: 關係代名詞引導形容詞子句修飾前面的名詞（先行詞）：人用 who/that，物用 which/that，所有格用 whose。
限定用法（不加逗號）用來指出是哪一個人或物，沒有它句意就不完整。
非限定用法（加逗號）只是補充說明，不可用 that，受格關代也不可省略。
關代在子句中已代替了名詞，不可再重複主詞或受詞。

examples.en: The boy who sits next to me is good at math.
examples.zh: 坐在我旁邊的那個男孩數學很好。

examples.en: The book that I borrowed from the library is very funny.
examples.zh: 我從圖書館借來的那本書很好笑。
hl: that I borrowed from the library

examples.en: My grandmother, who lives in Tainan, makes delicious rice cakes.
examples.zh: 我住在台南的外婆會做美味的年糕。

tip: 非限定用法不能用 that：✗ My bike, that is red, is new. ✓ My bike, which is red, is new. 也不要重複代名詞：✗ the man who he lives next door.

qs.s: The girl ______ won the singing contest is my cousin.
qs.ex: 先行詞是人且在子句中作主詞，用 who。

qs.s: I lost the umbrella ______ my aunt gave me last week.
qs.ex: 先行詞是物，關代作 gave 的受詞，用 that。

qs.s: Mr. Lin, ______ teaches us history, is very funny.
qs.ex: 有逗號的非限定用法不能用 that；先行詞是人，用 who。

qs.s: I have a friend ______ father is a famous chef.
qs.ex: 空格後的 father 是「朋友的爸爸」，需要所有格 whose。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: The man who he sits there is my uncle.
The pen which I bought it is blue.
The movie that we watched yesterday was great.
The student whose he lost the bag is crying.
qs.ex: C 正確。A、B、D 在關代之後又重複了代名詞，重複了子句中的主詞或受詞。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: My dog, that is only two years old, loves swimming.
My dog, what is only two years old, loves swimming.
My dog which, is only two years old, loves swimming.
My dog, which is only two years old, loves swimming.
qs.ex: 補充說明用有逗號的 which；that 與 what 都不能用在非限定用法，逗號位置也要在 which 之前。

title: 使役動詞 have / make
formula: have/make + O + V（原形）
points: 使役動詞表示「使、讓某人做某事」，受詞後面接原形動詞，不加 to。
have 的語氣平和，常表示請求或安排某人去做事。
make 帶有強迫或「使產生某種結果」的意味。
make 變成被動語態時，to 要補回來：We were made to clean the room.

examples.en: The teacher had us line up outside the classroom.
examples.zh: 老師請我們在教室外排隊。

examples.en: My little brother always makes me laugh.
examples.zh: 我的弟弟總是讓我發笑。

examples.en: Mom made Ken clean his room before dinner.
examples.zh: 媽媽要肯在晚餐前打掃房間。

tip: ✗ The teacher made us to clean the room. ✓ The teacher made us clean the room. 但被動時要補 to：We were made to clean the room.

qs.s: Our English teacher had us ______ a short speech every Friday.
qs.ex: have + O + 原形動詞，空格要填 give。

qs.s: The sad movie made several students ______ in the theater.
qs.ex: make + O + 原形動詞，不加 to。

qs.s: Dad made me ______ the dishes after I broke the cup.
qs.ex: make me 之後接原形動詞 wash。

qs.s: Please have the waiter ______ some more water to our table.
qs.ex: have + O + 原形，waiter 與 bring 是主動關係。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: My mom made me to finish my homework.
My mom made me finishing my homework.
My mom made me finish my homework.
My mom made me finished my homework.
qs.ex: made me 之後接原形動詞 finish；A 多了 to，B 用了 V-ing，D 用了過去式。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: The coach had the players to run ten laps.
The coach had the players run ten laps.
The coach had the players ran ten laps.
The coach had the players runs ten laps.
qs.ex: have + O + 原形，不加 to，也不加動詞變化。

title: 強調句型 It is ... that
formula: It is/was + 被強調部分 + that + ...
points: 強調句可強調主詞、受詞或時間、地點等副詞，被強調的部分夾在 It is/was 與 that 之間。
that 之後的部分是原句去掉被強調成分後的剩餘，時態要與原句一致。
強調人時 that 可換成 who；強調時間、地點副詞時仍用 that。
判斷方法：把 It is ... that 拿掉後，剩下的句子仍然完整，就是強調句。

examples.en: It was Amy that broke the window yesterday.
examples.zh: 昨天打破窗戶的是艾咪。

examples.en: It is in the library that I do my homework every day.
examples.zh: 我每天是在圖書館寫作業的。
hl: It is in the library that

examples.en: It was last Sunday that we went hiking.
examples.zh: 我們是上週日去健行的。

tip: 強調句的 be 動詞時態要配合原句：✗ It is Tom that broke the vase last week. ✓ It was Tom that broke the vase last week. 也不可用 what 取代 that。

qs.s: It was my brother ______ borrowed my bike without asking.
qs.ex: 強調句型 It was ... that，強調的是主詞 my brother。

qs.s: It is in the morning ______ I feel most energetic.
qs.ex: 強調時間副詞 in the morning，用 that 連接。

qs.s: ______ was at the school gate that we met our new teacher.
qs.ex: 強調句的句首要用 It。

qs.s: It ______ Lisa that won the first prize in last year's contest.
qs.ex: 原句時間是 last year，所以 be 動詞要用過去式 was。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: It was the red hat what I wanted to buy.
It was the red hat that I wanted to buy.
It the red hat was that I wanted to buy.
Was it the red hat that wanted I to buy.
qs.ex: B 正確。A 用了 what；C 與 D 的語序混亂。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: It is yesterday that we cleaned the classroom.
It was yesterday we that cleaned the classroom.
It was yesterday that we cleaned the classroom.
It was yesterday that cleaned we the classroom.
qs.ex: C 正確。A 的 is 與 yesterday 時態不符；B 的 we 放在 that 前面，語序錯誤；D 的 cleaned we 語序錯誤。

title: 使役動詞 have + O + p.p.
formula: have + O + p.p.
points: 表示「請人做某事」或「讓某事被完成」，受詞與動詞之間是被動關係，所以用過去分詞。
常見用法：have my hair cut、have the car repaired、have a tooth pulled。
也可表示遭遇不好的事：have my wallet stolen。
若受詞是主動去做動作的人，則用 have + O + 原形：have Tom fix my bike。

examples.en: I had my bike repaired at the shop near school.
examples.zh: 我請學校附近的店把腳踏車修好了。

examples.en: Ella will have her photo taken for the school ID card.
examples.zh: 艾拉會去拍學生證用的照片。

examples.en: Tom had his phone stolen on the crowded bus.
examples.zh: 湯姆在擁擠的公車上被偷了手機。

tip: 受詞與動詞是被動關係才用 p.p.：have my bike repaired；是主動關係用原形：have Tom repair my bike。✗ I had my hair cut by myself（自己剪時不用此句型）。

qs.s: I'm going to have my broken watch ______ tomorrow.
qs.ex: watch 是被修理的對象，用被動意義的過去分詞 fixed。

qs.s: Rita had her hair ______ at a new salon last weekend.
qs.ex: hair 被染，是被動關係，用 p.p. dyed。

qs.s: We had the classroom ______ by the cleaners during the winter break.
qs.ex: classroom 是被油漆的對象，要用 painted。

qs.s: Mr. Chen had his car ______ while he was shopping in the mall.
qs.ex: car 被偷，用 p.p. stolen；stole 是過去式，不可用在這個位置。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: I had my essay check by my teacher.
I had my essay checked by my teacher.
I had my essay checking by my teacher.
I had my essay to check by my teacher.
qs.ex: essay 與 check 是被動關係，需用過去分詞 checked。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: She had her picture take at the park.
She had her picture taking at the park.
She had her picture to take at the park.
She had her picture taken at the park.
qs.ex: have + O + p.p.，picture 是被拍的對象，用 taken。

title: 愈…愈…（比較級句型）
formula: The + 比較級 + S + V, the + 比較級 + S + V
points: 表示「愈…就愈…」，兩個比較級的前面各有一個 the。
前後兩個子句各有主詞與動詞，且前一個是條件或原因，後一個是結果。
形容詞或副詞的比較級依規則變化：hard → harder，多音節用 more。
口語中可以簡化，如 The sooner, the better.（愈快愈好）

examples.en: The more you practice, the better you play.
examples.zh: 你練習得愈多，就彈得愈好。
hl: The more you practice, the better you play

examples.en: The earlier we leave, the less traffic we will meet.
examples.zh: 我們愈早出發，就會遇到愈少車潮。
hl: The earlier we leave, the less traffic we will meet

examples.en: The longer I waited, the more nervous I felt.
examples.zh: 我等得愈久，就愈緊張。
hl: The longer I waited, the more nervous I felt

tip: ✗ The more you read, more you learn. ✓ The more you read, the more you learn.（兩個 the 都不能少）；也不能用原級：✗ The hard you work, the better results you get.

qs.s: The ______ you study, the better grades you will get.
qs.ex: 此句型要用比較級 harder，並且前面有 the。

qs.s: The more water you drink, ______ you will feel.
qs.ex: 後半句也要有 the + 比較級，所以是 the healthier。

qs.s: The faster he ran, ______ his heart beat.
qs.ex: 後半句要是 the + 比較級，不可省略 the。

qs.s: ______ you practice the piano, the more smoothly you will play.
qs.ex: 前半句也要用 the + 比較級，所以是 The more often。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: The more you eat, more you gain.
The more you eat, the more you gain.
More you eat, the more you gain.
The more you eat, the most you gain.
qs.ex: 兩個比較級前都要有 the，且不能用最高級 most。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: The higher we climbed, the cold the air became.
The high we climbed, the colder the air became.
The higher we climbed, colder the air became.
The higher we climbed, the colder the air became.
qs.ex: 前後都要用 the + 比較級；A 的 cold 是原級，B 的 high 是原級，C 缺少 the。

title: 分詞構句（表連續或附帶動作）
formula: S + V, V-ing / p.p. ...
points: 分詞構句是把連接詞與重複的主詞省略後，改用分詞表示的句型；兩個動作的主詞必須相同。
放在句尾時，常表示接續發生的動作、結果，或附帶的情況。
主詞與分詞是主動關係用 V-ing；是被動或感受情緒的關係用 p.p.（amazed, bored）。
分詞前面不用 and，也不重複主詞。

examples.en: Tim slipped on the wet floor, hurting his back.
examples.zh: 提姆在濕地板上滑倒，傷到了背。

examples.en: The boy sat alone in the corner, scared by the loud noise.
examples.zh: 那男孩獨自坐在角落，被巨大的聲響嚇到了。

examples.en: Lily opened the window, letting fresh air into the room.
examples.zh: 莉莉打開窗戶，讓新鮮空氣進到房間。
hl: letting fresh air into the room

tip: ✗ He fell, and breaking his leg. ✓ He fell, breaking his leg. 感到…的情緒用 p.p.：surprised, excited, bored。

qs.s: The little girl dropped her ice cream, ______ loudly.
qs.ex: 女孩與 cry 是主動關係，且接續發生，用 crying。

qs.s: Jack stood on the bridge, ______ by the beautiful sunset.
qs.ex: Jack 是被夕陽「驚艷」的人，用 p.p. amazed。

qs.s: The bus broke down on the highway, ______ us late for the concert.
qs.ex: 前面整件事造成結果，用 V-ing 表示結果，making us late。

qs.s: Mary closed the book, ______ proud of herself.
qs.ex: 主詞相同、動作同時發生，用 V-ing feeling；不可再用 feel 或 felt 與前句連接。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: He opened the door, and walking into the room.
He opened the door, walking into the room.
He opened the door, walked into the room.
He opened the door, to walk into the room.
qs.ex: 分詞構句直接用 V-ing，不加 and；C 與 D 的動詞形式皆不符。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: Tom sat on the sofa, boring by the long movie.
Tom sat on the sofa, bore by the long movie.
Tom sat on the sofa, bored by the long movie.
Tom sat on the sofa, being bore by the long movie.
qs.ex: Tom 是感到無聊的人，用 p.p. bored，而不是 boring。

title: 感官動詞＋受詞＋補語
formula: S + see/hear/feel/watch/notice + O + VR/V-ing/p.p.
points: 感官動詞（see、watch、hear、feel、notice 等）後面可接「受詞＋補語」，描述感官感受到的畫面或聲音。
補語用原形動詞（VR）：強調看到或聽到動作的完整過程，從頭到尾。
補語用 V-ing：強調動作正在進行，只看到或聽到其中一部分。
補語用 p.p.：受詞是動作的承受者，表示「被……」。

examples.en: I heard my neighbor sing in the hallway this morning.
examples.zh: 我今天早上聽到鄰居在走廊上唱歌。

examples.en: We watched the workers painting the school gate.
examples.zh: 我們看著工人們正在粉刷學校大門。

examples.en: Jack felt his shoulder touched by someone in the crowd.
examples.zh: 傑克感覺到肩膀被人群中的某人碰了一下。

tip: 感官動詞後的原形動詞前不加 to（主動語態）。錯：I saw him to enter the room. 對：I saw him enter the room.

qs.s: Last night I heard someone ______ outside my window.
qs.ex: hear 後接受詞再接原形動詞，不可加 to；sung 是過去分詞，語意為被唱，不合；sang 是過去式，不能直接放在受詞後。

qs.s: Mia felt her phone ______ in her pocket, so she took it out.
qs.ex: phone 與 vibrate 為主動關係，用 V-ing 或原形；feel 後不可接 to V，也不可用過去式或 be V-ing。

qs.s: Tom heard his name ______ from the back of the room.
qs.ex: 名字是「被叫」，受詞與動詞為被動關係，應用過去分詞 called。

qs.s: We watched the sun ______ slowly behind the mountains.
qs.ex: watch 後接受詞與原形動詞（或 V-ing），不可用 to set、第三人稱單數 sets 或帶 be 動詞的 was setting。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: Lisa heard her mother calling her from the kitchen.
Lisa heard her mother to call her from the kitchen.
Lisa heard her name call from the kitchen.
Lisa heard her mother called her from the kitchen.
qs.ex: 感官動詞後用 V-ing 或原形動詞。to call 與 called 都不合；her name 與 call 是被動關係，需用 called。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: I heard my name calling by someone in the hall.
I heard my name called by someone in the hall.
I heard my name to call by someone in the hall.
I heard my name to be call by someone in the hall.
qs.ex: 名字是「被叫」，受詞 my name 與補語是被動關係，用過去分詞 called；感官動詞後不接 to V。

title: 關係副詞 where／when
formula: …N(,) + where/when + S + V…
points: 先行詞是地點（place、city、café 等）時，用 where 引導形容詞子句；先行詞是時間（day、year、night 等）時，用 when。
where／when 本身已含有介系詞的意思（in which、at which、on which），所以後面接完整的子句（有主詞和動詞）。
前面加逗號是「非限定用法」，只補充說明先行詞；專有名詞（如地名、年份）常用這種用法。
非限定用法的 where／when 不可改成 that。

examples.en: The park where we play badminton is near my home.
examples.zh: 我們打羽毛球的那座公園離我家很近。

examples.en: I will never forget the summer when I learned to swim.
examples.zh: 我永遠不會忘記我學會游泳的那個夏天。

examples.en: We visited Kaohsiung, where my aunt runs a small shop.
examples.zh: 我們去了高雄，我阿姨在那裡經營一間小店。

tip: where／when 後面要接完整子句，不再缺主詞或受詞。錯：the place where I like. 對：the place where I often study.（或 the place which I like）

qs.s: This is the café ______ my friends and I often study after school.
qs.ex: 先行詞 café 是地點，後面子句完整，所以用關係副詞 where。

qs.s: I will never forget the day ______ I won the speech contest.
qs.ex: 先行詞 day 是時間，後面子句完整，用 when。

qs.s: We visited Tainan, ______ the street food is famous all over the country.
qs.ex: Tainan 是地點，前有逗號為非限定用法，需用 where；that 不可用於非限定子句。

qs.s: Saturday is the day ______ most students can finally sleep late.
qs.ex: Saturday 是時間，用 when 引導形容詞子句，where 用於地點。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: The library when I do my homework closes at nine.
The library where I do my homework closes at nine.
The library that I do my homework closes at nine.
The library in where I do my homework closes at nine.
qs.ex: library 是地點，用 where；when 用於時間，that 在此缺少介系詞，in where 則重複使用。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: I still remember the night where the whole city lost power.
I still remember the night which the whole city lost power.
I still remember the night what the whole city lost power.
I still remember the night when the whole city lost power.
qs.ex: night 是時間，且後面子句完整，只能用 when；where 用於地點，which 後缺少成分，what 不能修飾先行詞。

title: 過去完成式
formula: had + p.p.
points: 表示「在過去某個時間點之前，就已經發生或完成」的動作，比過去式更早。
常和過去式一起使用：先發生的用 had + p.p.，後發生的用過去式。
常見連接詞或片語：before、after、by the time、when、until。
否定為 had not (hadn't) + p.p.；疑問句把 Had 放到句首。

examples.en: When Ella reached the gym, the class had already begun.
examples.zh: 艾拉到體育館時，課已經開始了。

examples.en: I had never ridden a horse before I visited the farm.
examples.zh: 在參觀農場之前，我從沒騎過馬。

examples.en: He told me that he had lost his keys on the bus.
examples.zh: 他告訴我他的鑰匙掉在公車上了。

tip: 「過去的過去」才用過去完成式。had 後面一定接過去分詞。錯：I had finish it. 對：I had finished it.

qs.s: When we arrived at the station, the train ______ already left.
qs.ex: 到站是過去時間，火車在那之前就已離開，所以用過去完成式 had left。

qs.s: Lena realized she ______ her wallet at home only after she reached the store.
qs.ex: 發現是過去，忘記帶是更早發生，用 had left；has left 是現在完成式，不合過去情境。

qs.s: I ______ never seen snow until I traveled to Japan last winter.
qs.ex: until 所指的過去時間點之前的經驗，用 had never seen。

qs.s: After the students ______ the classroom, the teacher locked the door.
qs.ex: 鎖門是過去的動作，學生離開在此之前，用 had left。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: She had finished her homework before her mother came home.
She has finished her homework before her mother came home.
She had finishing her homework before her mother came home.
She had finish her homework before her mother came home.
qs.ex: had 後須接過去分詞 finished；has finished 為現在完成式，與 came home 的過去時間不合。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: By the time I got to the cinema, the movie has started.
By the time I got to the cinema, the movie have started.
By the time I got to the cinema, the movie had started.
By the time I got to the cinema, the movie will start.
qs.ex: by the time 搭配過去式時，另一子句用過去完成式 had started；has、have 或 will 都和過去時態不合。

title: 分詞片語修飾名詞
formula: N(,) + V-ing/p.p. …
points: 分詞片語可放在名詞後面，用來補充說明這個名詞，相當於省略關係代名詞的形容詞子句。
名詞與動作是主動關係，用現在分詞（V-ing）；是被動關係，用過去分詞（p.p.）。
例：The girl who is sitting by the window → The girl sitting by the window。
分詞片語前面加逗號，則是補充說明（非限定），常見於人名或特定事物之後。

examples.en: The boy reading under the tree is my classmate.
examples.zh: 在樹下看書的男孩是我的同學。

examples.en: The cake made by my sister was delicious.
examples.zh: 我姐姐做的蛋糕很好吃。

examples.en: Ms. Wang, standing near the door, smiled at us.
examples.zh: 王老師站在門邊對我們微笑。

tip: 分詞前不要再加動詞。錯：The man wore a cap is my uncle. 對：The man wearing a cap is my uncle.

qs.s: The girl ______ by the window is my cousin.
qs.ex: girl 與 sit 是主動關係，用現在分詞 sitting 修飾名詞，不可直接用原形或過去式。

qs.s: The cookies ______ by my grandmother taste wonderful.
qs.ex: cookies 是被烤的，被動關係，用過去分詞 baked。

qs.s: Mr. Lin, ______ English at our school, will retire next month.
qs.ex: Mr. Lin 是教書的人，主動關係，用 teaching；teaches 會使句子出現兩個動詞而缺連接詞。

qs.s: The window ______ by the strong wind last night has been fixed.
qs.ex: window 是被風吹壞的，被動關係，用過去分詞 broken。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: The man wearing a red cap is waiting at the gate.
The man worn a red cap is waiting at the gate.
The man wore a red cap is waiting at the gate.
The man wear a red cap is waiting at the gate.
qs.ex: man 與 wear 是主動關係，用 wearing 修飾；worn、wore、wear 都不能這樣放在名詞後。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: The photos taking during our trip are on my laptop.
The photos take during our trip are on my laptop.
The photos taken during our trip are on my laptop.
The photos took during our trip are on my laptop.
qs.ex: 照片是被拍的，用過去分詞 taken；taking、take、took 都不合。

title: 強調句型 All／What … is (to) VR
formula: All (that)/What + S + want/need/have to/can/should + do is + (to) VR
points: 表示「想要（需要、必須、應該）做的就是……」，用來強調 is／was 後面的重點。
All (that) 或 What 引導的名詞子句當主詞，視為單數，所以動詞用 is 或 was。
is／was 後面接 to VR，to 可以省略，所以也常見直接接原形動詞。
常用於建議、指示或說明做法。

examples.en: All you need to do is check the schedule.
examples.zh: 你只需要確認一下時間表。
hl: All you need to do is check

examples.en: What I want to do this weekend is to visit my grandparents.
examples.zh: 我這個週末想做的事是去探望祖父母。
hl: What I want to do this weekend is to visit

examples.en: What he had to do was apologize to his teammates.
examples.zh: 他必須做的事是向隊友道歉。
hl: What he had to do was apologize

tip: 主詞子句視為單數，動詞用 is／was；is 後面不接動名詞。錯：What you should do are to rest. 對：What you should do is (to) rest.

qs.s: All you have to do ______ to press this button.
qs.ex: All you have to do 是單數子句當主詞，動詞用 is。

qs.s: What I want to do now ______ take a long nap.
qs.ex: What 子句當主詞視為單數，動詞用 is，後面接原形動詞 take。

qs.s: What you should do is ______ more water every day.
qs.ex: is 後面接 (to) VR，此處省略 to，用原形 drink。

qs.s: ______ you need to do is to check your answers again.
qs.ex: What you need to do 是名詞子句，意思為「你需要做的事」，其他選項不能這樣使用。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: All you can do are wait for the test results.
All you can do is wait for the test results.
All you can do wait for the test results.
All you can do is waits for the test results.
qs.ex: 主詞子句為單數，需有 is；is 之後接 (to) VR，不是 are 或第三人稱的 waits。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: What we should do first are to clean the classroom.
What should we do first is to clean the classroom.
What we should do first is cleaned the classroom.
What we should do first is to clean the classroom.
qs.ex: What 子句保持直述句語序，動詞用 is，後接 to VR；其他選項動詞或語序有誤。

title: with 的附加狀況
formula: with + O + V-ing/p.p./adj./prep.
points: 「with + 受詞 + 補語」用來補充說明同時發生的狀態或附帶情況，意思是「……著」。
受詞與補語是主動關係，用 V-ing；是被動關係，用 p.p.。
補語也可以是形容詞或介系詞片語，例如 with the door open、with a book in his hand。
此結構是附加說明，不會讓句子多出一個動詞。

examples.en: Ben listened to the teacher with his arms crossed.
examples.zh: 班雙臂交叉聽老師說話。

examples.en: The little girl ran to me with tears rolling down her face.
examples.zh: 小女孩淚水滑落臉龐，跑向我。

examples.en: Don't speak with your mouth full of food.
examples.zh: 不要滿嘴食物地說話。

tip: with 後的受詞與補語的關係要判斷清楚：主動用 V-ing、被動用 p.p.。錯：with the light turning on（燈被開著）。對：with the light turned on.

qs.s: She sat on the sofa with her eyes ______ on the screen.
qs.ex: eyes 是被固定在螢幕上，被動關係，用過去分詞 fixed。

qs.s: Don't speak with your mouth ______ of food.
qs.ex: with + 受詞 + 形容詞，mouth full of food 表示嘴裡塞滿食物；filled of 並不通。

qs.s: The baby slept with the light ______ on.
qs.ex: 燈是被打開的，被動關係，用過去分詞 turned。

qs.s: He stood in the rain with water ______ down his face.
qs.ex: water 與 run 是主動關係，用現在分詞 running。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: He listened to music with his eyes closed.
He listened to music with his eyes closing.
He listened to music with his eyes close.
He listened to music with his eyes to close.
qs.ex: 眼睛是被閉上的，用 closed；其他補語形式與句意不合。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: The dog ran toward me with its tail wagged.
The dog ran toward me with its tail wagging.
The dog ran toward me with its tail wag.
The dog ran toward me with its tail to wag.
qs.ex: 尾巴會自己搖，主動關係，用 wagging；wagged、wag、to wag 都不正確。

title: keep／leave／find ＋ 受詞 ＋ 補語
formula: S + keep/leave/find + O + V-ing/p.p./adj./prep.
points: keep、leave、find 後面可接「受詞 + 補語」，表示讓受詞維持某種狀態，或發現受詞處於某種狀態。
補語可用 V-ing（主動、進行）、p.p.（被動）、形容詞或介系詞片語。
keep + O + V-ing：讓……一直做某事；leave + O + p.p./adj.：讓……處於某狀態；find + O + 補語：發現……是（在）某種情形。
這些動詞後面通常不接 to VR。

examples.en: The noise kept the baby crying all night.
examples.zh: 噪音讓寶寶整晚哭個不停。

examples.en: Please leave the window open for some fresh air.
examples.zh: 請讓窗戶開著，透透新鮮空氣。

examples.en: I found my notebook hidden under the sofa.
examples.zh: 我發現我的筆記本藏在沙發下面。

tip: 補語不能用 to VR，也要依主被動選 V-ing 或 p.p.。錯：I found my bag stealing. 對：I found my bag stolen.

qs.s: Sorry to keep you ______ so long.
qs.ex: keep + 受詞 + V-ing，表示讓某人一直等著。

qs.s: Please don't leave the door ______ when you go out.
qs.ex: leave + 受詞 + 形容詞，表示讓門保持開著的狀態。

qs.s: I found my sister ______ on the sofa with a book on her face.
qs.ex: find + 受詞 + V-ing，表示發現她正在睡覺，姐姐與睡覺是主動關係。

qs.s: Lily found her bike ______ when she came out of the library.
qs.ex: 腳踏車是被偷走的，被動關係，用過去分詞 stolen。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: The loud noise kept me to stay awake all night.
The loud noise kept awake me all night.
The loud noise kept me awake all night.
The loud noise kept me stay awake all night.
qs.ex: keep + 受詞 + 形容詞 awake，受詞要放在補語前，且不可加 to 或另接原形動詞。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: We found the museum crowd with visitors.
We found the museum crowded with visitors.
We found the museum to crowded with visitors.
We found the museum crowds with visitors.
qs.ex: find + 受詞 + p.p./adj.，crowded 表示擠滿人的狀態；其他選項詞性或形式不對。

title: 分詞構句
formula: (Conj.) V-ing/p.p. …, S + V …
points: 兩個子句主詞相同時，可把從屬子句簡化成分詞片語，放在主要子句前面。
做法：省略連接詞與主詞，主動語態用 V-ing，被動語態用 p.p.，否定則在分詞前加 not。
分詞的意義主詞必須和主要子句的主詞相同，否則會形成錯誤的「懸垂分詞」。
為了避免語意不清，可保留連接詞，例如 After eating、While waiting。

examples.en: Hearing the bell, the students ran to the classroom.
examples.zh: 聽到鐘聲，學生們跑向教室。

examples.en: Not wanting to wake the baby, she walked quietly.
examples.zh: 她不想吵醒寶寶，所以安靜地走路。
hl: Not wanting to wake the baby

examples.en: Surprised by the news, Jenny dropped her pen.
examples.zh: 聽到消息很驚訝，珍妮掉了筆。

tip: 分詞的動作者要與主要子句主詞一致。錯：Walking home, my phone rang.（電話不會走路）對：Walking home, I heard my phone ring.

qs.s: ______ for the bus, Ken kept looking at his phone.
qs.ex: Ken 是等車的人，主動關係，用 Waiting；其他形式不能作分詞構句。

qs.s: ______ by the loud noise, the baby began to cry.
qs.ex: 寶寶是被嚇到，被動關係，用過去分詞 Frightened。

qs.s: ______ what to say, Mia stayed silent.
qs.ex: 分詞構句的否定把 not 放在分詞前，且 Mia 是主動關係，用 Not knowing。

qs.s: ______ in a small village, Tom had never seen a skyscraper.
qs.ex: Tom 是被生下來的，被動關係，用過去分詞 Born。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: Walking home, I met my English teacher.
Walked home, I met my English teacher.
Walk home, I met my English teacher.
Walking home, my phone rang loudly.
qs.ex: 主詞 I 與 walking 是主動關係；其他選項的分詞形式錯誤，或主詞不是走路的人。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: Not wanted to be late, she ran to the bus stop.
Not wanting to be late, she ran to the bus stop.
Not want to be late, she ran to the bus stop.
Don't wanting to be late, she ran to the bus stop.
qs.ex: 分詞構句的否定是 Not + V-ing；其他選項動詞形式不合文法。

title: It is said that 句型
formula: It is said/believed/reported/… that + S + V …
points: 用虛主詞 it，表示「據說／據信／據報導……」，說的是大家的看法或客觀資訊。
that 子句是真正的主詞內容，常放在句尾。
常見動詞有 say、believe、report、think、expect、show 等，用被動語態。
常出現在新聞和說明文中，語氣較客觀、正式。

examples.en: It is said that laughing is good for your health.
examples.zh: 據說笑對健康有益。

examples.en: It is reported that the new library will open in May.
examples.zh: 據報導新圖書館將於五月啟用。

examples.en: It has been shown that sleep helps us remember things.
examples.zh: 研究顯示睡眠有助於我們記住事情。

tip: 動詞要用被動語態。錯：It says that tea is healthy. 對：It is said that tea is healthy.

qs.s: It ______ that sleeping eight hours helps students learn better.
qs.ex: it 是虛主詞，說法是「被說」，用被動 is said。

qs.s: It is ______ that the new bridge will open next spring.
qs.ex: is 後面接過去分詞，用被動語態 reported。

qs.s: ______ is believed that carrots are good for your eyes.
qs.ex: 虛主詞用 It，後接 that 子句，其他選項不能這樣使用。

qs.s: It has been ______ that regular exercise improves memory.
qs.ex: has been 後面接過去分詞，用被動語態 shown。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: It is believed that cats can sense danger.
It believes that cats can sense danger.
It is believed cats that can sense danger.
There is believed that cats can sense danger.
qs.ex: 句型為 It is believed that + 子句；其他選項誤用主動語態、語序或 There。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: It reports that the festival attracted ten thousand visitors.
It is reported that the festival attracted ten thousand visitors.
It is reported the festival that attracted ten thousand visitors.
It is reporting that the festival attracted ten thousand visitors.
qs.ex: 虛主詞 It 搭配被動 is reported，再接 that 子句；其他選項主被動或語序有誤。

title: 虛受詞 it（find/consider it + 形容詞 + to V）
formula: S + find/consider/think/make + it + adj. + to V / that 子句
points: 當受詞是很長的不定詞片語或子句時，先用虛受詞 it 放在動詞後面，真正的內容移到句尾。
常見動詞有 find、consider、think、make、feel，後面接形容詞或名詞作受詞補語。
it 只是形式上的受詞，本身沒有意義，真正的受詞是句尾的 to V 或 that 子句。
若受詞補語是名詞，句型為 make/consider it a rule/pity + to V。

examples.en: Most students find it hard to wake up early on Monday mornings.
examples.zh: 多數學生覺得星期一早上很難早起。
hl: find it hard to wake up

examples.en: The coach made it a rule to run two kilometers before practice.
examples.zh: 教練規定練習前要先跑兩公里。
hl: made it a rule to run

examples.en: I consider it important that everyone keeps the classroom clean.
examples.zh: 我認為每個人都保持教室整潔很重要。

tip: 不能省略 it。錯：I find hard to learn math. → 對：I find it hard to learn math.

qs.s: My brother finds ______ difficult to get up before seven o'clock.
qs.ex: 動詞 find 後面要用虛受詞 it，真正的受詞是後面的 to get up。其他選項不能充當形式受詞。

qs.s: The teacher thinks ______ necessary for us to review the lesson every day.
qs.ex: think + it + adj. + for sb to V，it 是虛受詞，故選 it。

qs.s: Jim finds it a pleasure ______ the elderly in his community.
qs.ex: 真正的受詞是句尾的不定詞片語，用 to + 原形動詞，所以選 to help。

qs.s: The new rule makes ______ impossible for students to enter the building after nine.
qs.ex: make + it + adj. + (for sb) to V，用 it 作虛受詞。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: I find exciting to meet people from other countries.
I find it exciting to meet people from other countries.
I find it exciting meeting to people from other countries.
I find that exciting to meet people from other countries.
qs.ex: find 後面必須有虛受詞 it，其餘選項分別漏掉 it、語序錯誤或誤用 that。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: Our teacher considers a good habit to take notes in class.
Our teacher considers it a good habit taking notes to in class.
Our teacher considers it a good habit to take notes in class.
Our teacher considers it to be a good habit take notes in class.
qs.ex: consider it + 名詞 + to V 是正確結構，其餘選項漏掉 it 或 to V 的形式有誤。

title: not...until...（直到...才...）
formula: S + (助動詞) + not + V + until + 時間／子句
points: not...until... 表示「直到某時才做某事」，主句用否定，until 後面接時間點或子句。
until 子句若表示未來，用現在式代替未來式，例如 until she comes back。
主句為肯定句時，until 表示動作持續到某時為止，例如 wait until。
中文常說「到...才」，但英文要用否定的 not 搭配 until。

examples.en: The shop does not open until ten o'clock on weekends.
examples.zh: 這家店週末要到十點才開門。

examples.en: Lisa didn't realize she had lost her keys until she got home.
examples.zh: 莉莎到家才發現鑰匙不見了。

examples.en: We won't start dinner until my father comes back.
examples.zh: 我們要等爸爸回來才開始吃晚餐。

tip: until 子句不可用 will。錯：Don't leave until the rain will stop. → 對：Don't leave until the rain stops.

qs.s: The library doesn't close ______ nine o'clock in the evening.
qs.ex: not...until... 表「直到⋯才⋯」：圖書館直到晚上九點才關門；during、for、since 都不能接這個時間點表達此意。

qs.s: I won't go to sleep until I ______ my homework.
qs.ex: until 子句表示未來時，要用現在式代替未來式，故選 finish。

qs.s: The children didn't stop playing ______ their mother called them.
qs.ex: 「直到...才停止」用 didn't...until。

qs.s: We ______ leave the park until the rain stopped.
qs.ex: 句意是「直到雨停才離開」，主句需用否定 didn't，與 until 搭配。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: She did not leave the classroom until everyone finished the test.
She did not leave the classroom until everyone will finish the test.
She left not the classroom until everyone finished the test.
She did leave the classroom until everyone finished the test.
qs.ex: until 子句不用 will；否定要用 did not；肯定句加 until 語意不符句意。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: Don't open the gift until your birthday will come.
Don't open the gift until your birthday comes.
Don't open the gift until come your birthday.
Open not the gift until your birthday comes.
qs.ex: until 子句用現在式表未來、語序為主詞加動詞；其餘選項有 will、倒裝或否定位置的錯誤。

title: not only...but also...（不但...而且...）
formula: not only A but also B
points: not only A but also B 連接兩個對等的成分，意思是「不但 A 而且 B」，A 與 B 詞性或結構要相同。
連接兩個主詞時，動詞與靠近的主詞（B）一致。
not only 置於句首時，前半句要倒裝，例如 Not only does she sing, but she also dances.
also 有時可省略，but 不能省略。

examples.en: The park is not only clean but also quiet.
examples.zh: 這座公園不但乾淨而且安靜。
hl: not only clean but also quiet

examples.en: Not only the students but also the teacher was excited about the trip.
examples.zh: 不只學生，連老師也對這次旅行感到興奮。
hl: Not only the students but also the teacher was

examples.en: He not only plays the piano but also writes his own songs.
examples.zh: 他不但會彈鋼琴，還自己寫歌。
hl: not only plays the piano but also writes

tip: 兩邊的結構要平行。錯：She is not only smart but also works hard. → 對：She is not only smart but also hardworking.

qs.s: Tom is not only good at math ______ good at music.
qs.ex: 固定搭配是 not only...but also...。

qs.s: Not only the players but also the coach ______ happy about the result.
qs.ex: 動詞與靠近的主詞 the coach 一致，過去式單數用 was。

qs.s: The restaurant is famous not only for its food ______ for its friendly staff.
qs.ex: not only A but also B 為固定搭配，其餘選項無法連接兩個對等成分。

qs.s: Not only ______ the guitar, but she also sings very well.
qs.ex: not only 置於句首時，前半句要倒裝，用 does she play。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: My sister not only cooks well but also cleans the house every day.
My sister not only cooks well but also clean the house every day.
My sister not only cooks well but also cleaning the house every day.
My sister not only is cooks well but also cleans the house every day.
qs.ex: 兩個動詞都要用相同的第三人稱單數形，並保持結構平行；其他選項有動詞形式錯誤。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: This book is not only interesting and also useful for learning English.
This book is not only interesting but also usefully for learning English.
This book is not only interesting but also useful for learning English.
This book is interesting not only but also useful for learning English.
qs.ex: not only 要直接放在對等成分前，並與 but also 搭配，且詞性要平行；其他選項把 but 誤寫成 and，或把形容詞寫成副詞，或把 not only 放錯位置。

title: 被動不定詞表「據說／被認為」（be said/believed to V）
formula: S + be said/thought/believed/known to + V（to have p.p.）
points: 「It is said that...」可改成「S + be said to V」，把子句主詞移到句首，更簡潔。
常見動詞有 say、think、believe、know、report、consider。
不定詞表示與主要動詞同一時間或之後，用 to V；若表示更早發生的事，用 to have + p.p.。
這個句型常用於說明傳說、研究結果或一般人的看法。

examples.en: The old temple is believed to be over five hundred years old.
examples.zh: 這座古廟據信有五百多年歷史。

examples.en: The singer is said to have lost her phone on the train.
examples.zh: 據說那位歌手把手機掉在火車上。

examples.en: Dolphins are known to be very smart animals.
examples.zh: 眾所周知海豚是很聰明的動物。

tip: 若動作發生在更早，必須用完成式不定詞。錯：He is said to win the prize last year. → 對：He is said to have won the prize last year.

qs.s: This old bridge is believed ______ by farmers many years ago.
qs.ex: 橋是被建造的，且發生在過去，所以用被動完成式不定詞 to have been built。

qs.s: The rock star is said ______ very wealthy.
qs.ex: be said to V 表示「據說」，to 後接原形動詞。

qs.s: This kind of tea is thought ______ people stay healthy.
qs.ex: be thought to V，to 後接原形動詞。

qs.s: The boy is reported ______ the lost wallet before the police arrived.
qs.ex: 發現錢包在警察抵達之前，是較早的動作，用 to have found。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: The village is believed to have been founded in the 1800s.
The village is believed to found in the 1800s.
The village is believed to have found in the 1800s.
The village believes to have been founded in the 1800s.
qs.ex: 村莊是被建立的，且是過去的事，用 to have been founded；其他選項被動或完成式有誤。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: Cats say to be able to see in the dark.
Cats are said being able to see in the dark.
Cats are said to be able to see in the dark.
Cats are said that be able to see in the dark.
qs.ex: be said to V 後面直接接不定詞，不能加 that 或使用動名詞，主詞 cats 也要用被動。

title: 感官動詞的被動（be seen/heard + V-ing）
formula: S + be + seen/heard/watched/noticed + V-ing（主動：see + O + V/V-ing）
points: 感官動詞 see、hear、watch、notice 等主動時，後面可接「受詞 + 原形動詞或 V-ing」。
改成被動後，原形動詞前要加 to，V-ing 則保持不變：S + be seen to V / V-ing。
接 V-ing 表示動作正在進行；接原形（被動時 to V）表示看見整個動作的過程。
被動語態中 by 後面的行為者常省略，句子重點放在被看到或聽到的事。

examples.en: The boy was seen climbing over the school fence.
examples.zh: 有人看到那個男孩正在翻越學校的圍牆。

examples.en: The singer was heard practicing in the music room late at night.
examples.zh: 有人聽到那位歌手深夜在音樂教室練習。

examples.en: A stranger was noticed standing outside the gate for an hour.
examples.zh: 有人注意到一個陌生人在大門外站了一個小時。

tip: 主動時省略 to，被動時要加回 to。錯：He was seen leave the room. → 對：He was seen to leave the room. / He was seen leaving the room.

qs.s: The thief was seen ______ out of the window.
qs.ex: 感官動詞被動後接 V-ing 表示正在進行，jump 要用 jumping。

qs.s: The young man was heard ______ loudly in the next room.
qs.ex: was heard + V-ing，表示聽到某人正在大笑。

qs.s: The little girl was seen ______ across the street by herself.
qs.ex: 感官動詞被動後若接原形動詞，要加 to，故用 to cross。

qs.s: The students were noticed ______ notes during the exam.
qs.ex: 被動語態後接 V-ing，表示被發現正在做某事。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: The cat was seen sleep on the sofa.
The cat was seen sleeping on the sofa.
The cat saw sleeping on the sofa.
The cat was seeing sleeping on the sofa.
qs.ex: 被動語態要用 was seen，其後接 V-ing；其他選項把被動誤寫為主動或進行式，或漏掉 to。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: Some boys heard singing in the hallway.
Some boys were heard to singing in the hallway.
Some boys were heard singing in the hallway.
Some boys were hearing sing in the hallway.
qs.ex: 正確結構為 be heard + V-ing；其他選項缺少 be 動詞，或 to 後誤接 V-ing，或形式混亂。

title: 強調句型 It is not until...that...
formula: It is/was not until + 時間／子句 + that + S + V
points: 此句型用來強調「直到某時才...」，把 not until 的部分放在 it is/was 後面。
that 後面接一個完整的子句，動詞用肯定形式，不再使用否定。
時態依事件而定，過去的事用 It was not until...that...。
可從 not...until... 改寫：She didn't leave until noon. → It was not until noon that she left.

examples.en: It was not until midnight that the fans left the stadium.
examples.zh: 直到半夜球迷才離開體育場。
hl: It was not until midnight that

examples.en: It is not until we lose something that we know its value.
examples.zh: 直到失去某樣東西，我們才知道它的價值。
hl: It is not until we lose something that

examples.en: It was not until last week that I learned how to swim.
examples.zh: 直到上週我才學會游泳。
hl: It was not until last week that

tip: that 後面的動詞用肯定式，不再用否定。錯：It was not until ten that she didn't come. → 對：It was not until ten that she came.

qs.s: It was not until she opened the box ______ she saw the gift.
qs.ex: 強調句型 It was not until...that...，空格填 that。

qs.s: It was not until the sun set ______ the farmers went home.
qs.ex: 結構為 It was not until + 子句 + that + 子句。

qs.s: It was not until midnight that the storm ______.
qs.ex: that 後面的子句動詞用肯定式，故選 stopped，不能再加 not。

qs.s: ______ was not until 1990 that the school built a swimming pool.
qs.ex: 強調句型的開頭為虛主詞 It。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: It was not until yesterday that I heard the news.
It was not until yesterday that I didn't hear the news.
It not was until yesterday that I heard the news.
It was until yesterday not that I heard the news.
qs.ex: 正確語序為 It was not until...that...，其他選項多出否定或語序錯誤。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: It not is until we get sick that we value our health.
It is not until we get sick that we value our health.
It is not until we get sick we that value our health.
It is not until we get sick that we won't value our health.
qs.ex: that 要放在時間子句後、主要子句前；其他選項語序或否定使用有誤。

title: 同位語子句（the fact that + S + V）
formula: the fact / news / idea / belief / hope + that + S + V
points: 某些抽象名詞（fact、news、idea、belief、hope、rumor）後面可接 that 子句，用來說明該名詞的內容。
that 子句是完整句子，that 在子句中不作主詞或受詞，也不能用 what 或 which 取代。
這與關係代名詞 that 不同：關係子句缺主詞或受詞，同位語子句則完整。
常見用法：Despite the fact that...、The news that...、The idea that...

examples.en: The fact that she speaks four languages surprised her classmates.
examples.zh: 她會說四種語言的事實讓同學們很驚訝。
hl: The fact that she speaks four languages

examples.en: We were happy to hear the news that our school team had won.
examples.zh: 聽到我們學校隊伍贏了的消息，我們很高興。
hl: the news that our school team had won

examples.en: Many people share the belief that hard work leads to success.
examples.zh: 很多人認同努力工作會帶來成功的信念。
hl: the belief that hard work leads to success

tip: 同位語子句不能用 what 或 which 代替 that。錯：The fact what he lied upset us. → 對：The fact that he lied upset us.

qs.s: The fact ______ he was late again made the teacher angry.
qs.ex: fact 後面的同位語子句用 that 引導，說明事實內容。

qs.s: I was glad to hear the news ______ my cousin had passed the exam.
qs.ex: news 後接同位語子句，that 引導完整句子。

qs.s: Do you agree with the idea ______ students should wear uniforms?
qs.ex: idea 的內容是一個完整句子，用 that 引導同位語子句。

qs.s: ______ the fact that it was raining, we still went hiking.
qs.ex: 後面接名詞片語 the fact that...，需用介系詞 Despite。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: The fact that he forgot my birthday made me sad.
The fact what he forgot my birthday made me sad.
The fact he forgot that my birthday made me sad.
The fact that forgot my birthday made me sad.
qs.ex: 同位語 that 子句需完整含主詞與動詞；其他選項用錯連接詞或缺少主詞。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: There is no proof what the story is true.
There is no proof that is the story true.
There is no proof that the story is true.
There is no proof the story that is true.
qs.ex: proof 後面接 that + 完整子句；其他選項用錯關係詞、倒裝或 that 位置錯誤。

title: 數量詞 + of + 關係代名詞
formula: 名詞, some/many/most/all/both/one of + whom/which + V
points: 非限定關係子句可用「數量詞 + of + whom/which」補充說明先行詞的一部分。
指人時用 whom，指物時用 which，前面常出現 some、many、most、all、both、neither、one、two 等。
關係代名詞前有 of，因此指人要用受格 whom，不用 who。
動詞的單複數由前面的數量詞決定，例如 both of which are；one of which is。

examples.en: Our school has fifty clubs, some of which meet on weekends.
examples.zh: 我們學校有五十個社團，其中一些在週末聚會。

examples.en: She invited ten classmates, most of whom brought small gifts.
examples.zh: 她邀請了十位同學，其中大多數人帶了小禮物。

examples.en: My uncle has two cars, one of which is electric.
examples.zh: 我叔叔有兩輛車，其中一輛是電動車。

tip: 指人用 whom，不能用 who 或 which。錯：He has three sisters, two of who are doctors. → 對：two of whom are doctors.

qs.s: The class has thirty students, most of ______ live near the school.
qs.ex: 先行詞是人，介系詞 of 後面要用受格關係代名詞 whom。

qs.s: The store sells many kinds of bread, some of ______ are made without sugar.
qs.ex: 先行詞是物，用 some of which 引導非限定關係子句，them 無法連接兩個子句。

qs.s: I have two brothers, both of ______ study abroad.
qs.ex: 先行詞是人，用 both of whom。

qs.s: The museum has hundreds of paintings, ______ are over a century old.
qs.ex: 先行詞是物，用 many of which；them 無法連接子句，whom 用於人。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: She read five books last month, two of which were about space.
She read five books last month, two of them were about space.
She read five books last month, two of whom were about space.
She read five books last month, two of what were about space.
qs.ex: 指物且需連接兩個子句，用 two of which；其他選項用 them 無連接詞、whom 用於人、what 用法錯誤。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: The tourists, many of who were students, enjoyed the trip.
The tourists, many of whom were students, enjoyed the trip.
The tourists, many of which were students, enjoyed the trip.
The tourists, many of them were students, enjoyed the trip.
qs.ex: 先行詞是人，of 後面要用 whom；其他選項誤用 who、which 或 them。

title: 否定副詞置於句首的倒裝
formula: Never / Seldom / Rarely / Hardly / Little + 助動詞 + S + V
points: 將 never、seldom、rarely、hardly、little 等否定副詞放在句首以強調時，句子要倒裝。
倒裝規則：助動詞或 be 動詞放到主詞前；一般動詞則借用 do/does/did，動詞改為原形。
完成式或已有助動詞的句子，直接把助動詞移到主詞之前，例如 Never have I seen...。
這是較正式的強調用法，常見於演講、寫作與大考閱讀。

examples.en: Never have I seen such a beautiful sunset.
examples.zh: 我從未見過這麼美的日落。

examples.en: Rarely does my brother eat breakfast at home.
examples.zh: 我哥哥很少在家吃早餐。

examples.en: Seldom was the library so quiet during exam week.
examples.zh: 考試週時圖書館很少這麼安靜。

tip: 倒裝後一般動詞要用原形。錯：Rarely does he goes out. → 對：Rarely does he go out.

qs.s: Never ______ so many people in the night market.
qs.ex: 否定副詞 never 置於句首，後面要倒裝，完成式把 have 放在主詞前。

qs.s: Seldom ______ to school late because he lives nearby.
qs.ex: 一般動詞倒裝需借用 does，動詞用原形 come。

qs.s: Little ______ that the surprise party was for her.
qs.ex: little 置於句首表強調，後面用助動詞倒裝 did she know。

qs.s: Rarely ______ such a polite student in this school.
qs.ex: rarely 置句首須倒裝，助動詞 do 在主詞前，動詞為原形 find。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: Hardly had we arrived when it began to rain.
Hardly we had arrived when it began to rain.
Hardly had arrived we when it began to rain.
Hardly did we arrived when it began to rain.
qs.ex: hardly 置句首須倒裝，過去完成式把 had 放在主詞前；其他選項語序或動詞形式錯誤。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: Never my parents did argue in front of us.
Never did my parents argued in front of us.
Never did my parents argue in front of us.
Never argued my parents in front of us.
qs.ex: never 置句首：did + 主詞 + 原形動詞；其他選項未倒裝、動詞形式錯誤，或一般動詞直接倒裝。

title: 要求、建議類動詞後的 that 子句
formula: S + suggest / insist / demand / recommend + that + S + (should) + V原形
points: 表示「建議、要求、堅持、命令」的動詞（suggest, recommend, insist, demand, require, order, propose）後接 that 子句時，子句動詞用「(should) + 原形動詞」。
子句主詞即使是第三人稱單數，動詞也不加 -s；即使主要動詞是過去式，子句動詞仍用原形。
否定時用 (should) not + V原形，不需借助 do。
注意：insist 若表示「堅稱某事為事實」，則依事實的時態，不用原形。

examples.en: Our teacher suggested that we review Lesson 3 before the quiz.
examples.zh: 老師建議我們在小考前複習第三課。

examples.en: The doctor insists that my brother get more sleep every night.
examples.zh: 醫生堅持我弟弟每晚要多睡一點。

examples.en: The rules require that every student wear a name tag.
examples.zh: 規定要求每位學生都要戴名牌。

tip: that 子句的動詞不隨主詞或時態變化。錯：The coach demanded that he runs faster. 對：The coach demanded that he (should) run faster.

qs.s: The manager suggested that Emily ______ the report again before sending it.
qs.ex: suggest 後的 that 子句用 (should) + 原形動詞，故用 check，主詞 Emily 雖為單數也不加 -s。

qs.s: My parents insisted that I ______ home before ten o'clock last night.
qs.ex: insist 表示「堅持要求」時，that 子句用原形動詞，be 為正確形式。

qs.s: The school requires that all visitors ______ in at the front desk.
qs.ex: require 後的 that 子句用 (should) + 原形，故選 sign。

qs.s: The doctor advised that Grandpa ______ any heavy food at night.
qs.ex: advise 後的 that 子句用 (should) + 原形，否定為 not + 原形，故選 not eat。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: The guide recommended that we bring warm clothes to the mountain.
The guide recommended that we brought warm clothes to the mountain.
The guide recommended that we to bring warm clothes to the mountain.
The guide recommended that we bringing warm clothes to the mountain.
qs.ex: recommend 後的 that 子句動詞用原形 bring；其他選項分別誤用過去式、to V 與 V-ing。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: Mom demanded that my sister cleans her room right away.
Mom demanded that my sister cleaned her room right away.
Mom demanded that my sister clean her room right away.
Mom demanded that my sister should to clean her room right away.
qs.ex: demand 後的 that 子句用原形動詞 clean；其他選項分別誤加 -s、誤用過去式，或 should 後誤接 to。

title: 與現在事實相反的假設語氣
formula: If + S + 過去式 (be 用 were), S + would / could / might + V原形
points: 假設與現在事實相反的情況時，if 子句用過去式，主要子句用 would / could / might + 原形動詞。
if 子句中的 be 動詞不論主詞是什麼，正式用法都用 were，例如 If I were you。
主要子句的 would 表示「就會」，could 表示「就能」，might 表示「也許會」。
這類句子表示現在並非如此，只是想像或提出假想。

examples.en: If I had a bike, I would ride to school every day.
examples.zh: 如果我有一輛腳踏車，我每天都會騎去學校。

examples.en: If Tom were taller, he could join the basketball team.
examples.zh: 如果湯姆再高一點，他就能加入籃球隊。

examples.en: What would you do if you won a free trip to Japan?
examples.zh: 如果你贏得一趟免費的日本旅行，你會怎麼做？

tip: if 子句與主要子句不要同時用 would。錯：If I would have time, I would help you. 對：If I had time, I would help you.

qs.s: If I ______ the answer, I would tell you right now.
qs.ex: 與現在事實相反，if 子句用過去式，故選 knew。

qs.s: If Lisa ______ here now, she would help us carry these boxes.
qs.ex: 主要子句用 would help，表示與現在事實相反（Lisa 現在不在），if 子句用 were。

qs.s: If it ______ outside today, we would play baseball after school.
qs.ex: 與現在事實相反的假設，if 子句用過去式，故選 didn't rain。

qs.s: If I ______ you, I would talk to the teacher about the problem.
qs.ex: If I were you 是常見的假設用法，be 動詞用 were。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: If we have more time, we could visit the science museum.
If we had more time, we could visit the science museum.
If we would have more time, we could visit the science museum.
If we had more time, we can visit the science museum.
qs.ex: 與現在事實相反，if 子句用過去式 had，主要子句用 could。其他選項時態或助動詞錯誤。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: If Ben was good at math, he will not ask me for help.
If Ben is good at math, he would not ask me for help.
If Ben were good at math, he would not ask me for help.
If Ben would be good at math, he would not ask me for help.
qs.ex: 正確句用 were 搭配 would not + 原形。其他選項混用時態，或在 if 子句中使用 would。

title: It is + 形容詞 + that 子句（原形動詞）
formula: It is + important / necessary / urgent / essential + that + S + (should) + V原形
points: 表示「重要、必要、緊急」等評價的形容詞後接 that 子句時，子句動詞用 (should) + 原形。
常見形容詞：important, necessary, essential, crucial, vital, urgent, imperative。
主要子句可用 It is 或 It was，但 that 子句動詞仍不隨時態變化。
否定時用 (should) not + V原形。

examples.en: It is essential that every student arrive on time for the exam.
examples.zh: 每位學生準時到考場是非常重要的。

examples.en: It was necessary that the team practice every morning.
examples.zh: 球隊當時有必要每天早上練習。

examples.en: It is important that you not forget your passport.
examples.zh: 你不要忘記帶護照是很重要的。

tip: 形容詞後面的 that 子句不是陳述事實，所以不加 -s 或過去式。錯：It is vital that she goes now. 對：It is vital that she (should) go now.

qs.s: It is important that every member ______ the safety rules.
qs.ex: important 後的 that 子句用 (should) + 原形，故選 follow。

qs.s: It was necessary that the doctor ______ the patient immediately.
qs.ex: necessary 後的 that 子句用原形動詞，雖然主要子句是過去式也不變。

qs.s: It is urgent that the boys ______ out of the building right now.
qs.ex: urgent 後的 that 子句用 (should) + 原形，故選 get。

qs.s: It is vital that Mia ______ late for her job interview tomorrow.
qs.ex: 否定形式為 (should) not + 原形，故選 not be。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: It is crucial that he take his medicine on time.
It is crucial that he takes his medicine on time.
It is crucial that he took his medicine on time.
It is crucial that he taking his medicine on time.
qs.ex: crucial 後的 that 子句動詞用原形 take，不加 -s；其他選項為 -s、過去式與 V-ing。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: It was essential that we left before the storm came.
It was essential that we leaving before the storm came.
It was essential that we leave before the storm came.
It was essential that we to leave before the storm came.
qs.ex: essential 後的 that 子句用原形 leave，不隨主要子句的過去式變化。其他選項形式錯誤。

title: seem / appear + to V（to have p.p.）
formula: S + seem / appear + to + V原形　／　S + seem / appear + to have + p.p.
points: seem 與 appear 後接不定詞表示「似乎」，to + 原形表示與現在同時的狀態。
to have + p.p. 表示「似乎已經…」，所指的事發生在更早的時間。
He seems to know 可改寫為 It seems that he knows；兩者意思相同。
seem 是連綴動詞，通常不用進行式，也不能用被動。

examples.en: My little sister seems to enjoy her new school.
examples.zh: 我妹妹似乎很喜歡她的新學校。

examples.en: The streets are wet, so it appears to have rained last night.
examples.zh: 街道是濕的，所以昨晚似乎下過雨。

examples.en: Our neighbors seem to have moved away already.
examples.zh: 我們的鄰居似乎已經搬走了。

tip: to have p.p. 表示動作比 seem 更早發生。要說「似乎已經感冒了」要用 seems to have caught a cold，而非 seems to catch。

qs.s: The little boy seems ______ his way in the crowded market.
qs.ex: 表示「似乎已經迷路」，動作發生在 seems 之前，用 to have + p.p.，故選 to have lost。

qs.s: Everyone in the room seems ______ interested in the new teacher's story.
qs.ex: seem 後接 to + 原形，故選 to be。

qs.s: The ground is covered with leaves, so it appears ______ very hard last night.
qs.ex: 昨晚的事發生在說話之前，用 to have + p.p.，故選 to have blown。

qs.s: The streets are empty. Everyone seems ______ for the holiday already.
qs.ex: 「似乎已經離開了」用 to have + p.p.；seem 後不能直接接完成式動詞 has left。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: Dad seems to has forgotten the keys at home.
Dad seems forgot the keys at home.
Dad seems to have forgotten the keys at home.
Dad seems forgetting the keys at home.
qs.ex: seem 後接 to have + p.p. 表示過去已發生的事，故正確。其他選項動詞形式錯誤。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: The test appears to being easy for most students.
The test appears to be easy for most students.
The test appears be easy for most students.
The test appears easily for most students.
qs.ex: appear 後用 to + 原形 be。其他選項誤用 to being、缺少 to，或誤用副詞 easily。

title: 與過去事實相反的假設語氣
formula: If + S + had + p.p., S + would / could / might + have + p.p.
points: 假設與過去事實相反的情況時，if 子句用過去完成式 had + p.p.。
主要子句用 would / could / might + have + p.p.，表示「當時就會、就能…」。
這類句子常用來表達後悔、遺憾或慶幸。
if 子句和主要子句都不用過去簡單式或 will。

examples.en: If I had studied harder, I would have passed the test.
examples.zh: 如果我當時更用功，我就通過考試了。

examples.en: If the bus had come earlier, we could have caught the train.
examples.zh: 如果公車早點來，我們就趕得上火車了。

examples.en: She might have won the game if she had practiced more.
examples.zh: 如果她多練習，她也許就贏得比賽了。

tip: 與過去事實相反要用 had p.p.，不能用 would have。錯：If I would have known, I would have told you. 對：If I had known, I would have told you.

qs.s: If I ______ the alarm, I would not have been late for school.
qs.ex: 與過去事實相反，if 子句用 had + p.p.，故選 had heard。

qs.s: If Anna had asked me, I ______ her with the homework.
qs.ex: 主要子句用 would have + p.p. 表示對過去的假設，故選 would have helped。

qs.s: We ______ to the zoo yesterday if it had not rained.
qs.ex: if 子句為 had not rained，主要子句用 would have + p.p.，故選 would have gone。

qs.s: If the driver ______ more carefully, the accident might not have happened.
qs.ex: 與過去事實相反，if 子句用 had + p.p.，故選 had driven。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: If he had saved enough money, he could have bought the camera.
If he saved enough money, he could have bought the camera.
If he would have saved enough money, he could have bought the camera.
If he had saved enough money, he could buy the camera yesterday.
qs.ex: 過去假設為 had + p.p. 搭配 could have + p.p.。其他選項時態或助動詞不符。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: If you told me the truth, I would have forgiven you.
If you had told me the truth, I would have forgiven you.
If you had told me the truth, I would forgive you yesterday.
If you would have told me the truth, I would have forgiven you.
qs.ex: if 子句用 had told，主要子句用 would have forgiven。其他選項在時態或 would have 位置上有誤。

title: Not until 置於句首的倒裝
formula: Not until + 子句／時間詞, + 助動詞／be + S + V…
points: not until 引導的子句或時間詞放在句首時，主要子句要倒裝，意思是「直到…才…」。
倒裝方式：be 動詞或助動詞移到主詞前，一般動詞則借助 do / does / did。
not until 子句本身不倒裝，只有後面的主要子句倒裝。
未倒裝的寫法為 S + not + V + until...，例如 I did not leave until he came。

examples.en: Not until the bell rang did the students leave the classroom.
examples.zh: 直到鈴響，學生才離開教室。

examples.en: Not until last year did my uncle learn how to swim.
examples.zh: 直到去年我叔叔才學會游泳。

examples.en: Not until we got home were we able to eat dinner.
examples.zh: 直到到家我們才吃得到晚餐。

tip: 倒裝的是主要子句，not until 子句不倒裝。錯：Not until I came home I called her. 對：Not until I came home did I call her.

qs.s: Not until the movie ended ______ the lights come on.
qs.ex: 主要子句是過去式，一般動詞 come 前借助 did 倒裝，故選 did。

qs.s: Not until midnight ______ the little boy fall asleep.
qs.ex: 倒裝句中一般動詞 fall 需借助助動詞，過去時態用 did。

qs.s: Not until you finish your homework ______ allowed to play games.
qs.ex: 主要子句倒裝，be 動詞 are 放在主詞 you 前，故選 are you。

qs.s: Not until she arrived at the station ______ that she had left her bag at home.
qs.ex: 主要子句倒裝，助動詞 did 放在主詞前，故為 did she realize。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: Not until the rain stopped we went outside.
Not until the rain stopped did we went outside.
Not until the rain stopped did we go outside.
Not until did the rain stop we went outside.
qs.ex: 主要子句要倒裝為 did we go；其他選項沒有倒裝、助動詞後仍用過去式，或把 not until 子句誤倒裝。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: Not until he apologized she was willing to talk to him.
Not until he apologized was willing she to talk to him.
Not until he apologized was she willing to talk to him.
Not until he apologized, willing was she to talk to him.
qs.ex: 主要子句 be 動詞 was 放主詞前，為 was she willing；其他選項未倒裝或倒裝位置錯誤。

title: If it were not for... / If it had not been for...
formula: If it were not for + N, S + would + V　／　If it had not been for + N, S + would have + p.p.
points: If it were not for + 名詞 表示「若非有…（現在）」，主要子句用 would / could + 原形。
If it had not been for + 名詞 表示「若當時沒有…」，主要子句用 would have + p.p.。
可用 Without + 名詞 或 But for + 名詞 改寫，意思相近。
常用來表達感謝、慶幸，說明某人或某物的重要。

examples.en: If it were not for the Internet, we would not find information so quickly.
examples.zh: 如果沒有網路，我們不會這麼快找到資料。

examples.en: If it had not been for your advice, I would have made a big mistake.
examples.zh: 如果沒有你的建議，我就會犯下大錯。
hl: If it had not been for

examples.en: Without my alarm clock, I would be late for school every day.
examples.zh: 如果沒有鬧鐘，我每天都會遲到。

tip: If it were not for 後面接名詞，不接完整子句。錯：If it were not for he helped me... 對：If it were not for his help, ...

qs.s: If it ______ for the nurse's quick action, the patient would be in danger now.
qs.ex: 現在的假設用 If it were not for，故選 were not。

qs.s: If it ______ for your help last week, I would have failed the project.
qs.ex: 表示過去事實相反，用 If it had not been for，故選 had not been。

qs.s: If it were not for the sun, all plants ______ to grow.
qs.ex: If it were not for 為現在假設，主要子句用 would + 原形，故選 would fail。

qs.s: If it had not been for the map, we ______ lost in the forest.
qs.ex: If it had not been for 後主要子句用 would have + p.p.，故選 would have gotten。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: If it were not for music, my life would be dull.
If it is not for music, my life would be dull.
If it were not for music, my life will be dull.
If it were not for music is my life, it would be dull.
qs.ex: If it were not for + 名詞，主要子句用 would + 原形。其他選項時態、助動詞或句構錯誤。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: If it had not been for her kindness, I would feel lonely then.
If it had not been for her kindness, I would have felt lonely.
If it were not for her kindness, I would have felt lonely.
If it had not been her kindness, I would have felt lonely.
qs.ex: 過去假設為 had not been for 搭配 would have + p.p.。其他選項時態不符或漏了 for。

title: Only + 副詞片語／子句 置於句首的倒裝
formula: Only + 副詞（片語／子句）+ 助動詞／be + S + V…
