points: only 加上副詞、介系詞片語或子句放在句首時，後面的主要子句要倒裝，以加強語氣。
倒裝方式：be 動詞或助動詞移到主詞前，一般動詞則借助 do / does / did。
常見形式：Only then, Only by + V-ing, Only when..., Only after..., Only in this way。
only 修飾主詞時不倒裝，例如 Only Tom knows the answer。

examples.en: Only by working together can we finish this project on time.
examples.zh: 只有一起努力，我們才能準時完成這個專案。

examples.en: Only after the test did Amy feel relaxed.
examples.zh: 直到考試結束後，艾咪才覺得放鬆。

examples.en: Only when you ask politely will the clerk help you.
examples.zh: 只有在你客氣詢問時，店員才會幫你。

tip: 倒裝的是主要子句，只有 only + 副詞成分在句首才倒裝。錯：Only then I understood. 對：Only then did I understand.

qs.s: Only in this way ______ solve the problem.
qs.ex: only + 副詞片語在句首，後面倒裝，助動詞 can 放主詞 we 前，故選 can we。

qs.s: Only after dinner last night ______ my brother finish his homework.
qs.ex: Only + 時間副詞置句首要倒裝；last night 是過去，句中動詞 finish 為原形，故用助動詞 did。

qs.s: Only when the teacher came in ______ quiet.
qs.ex: only when 子句在句首，主要子句倒裝，故為 did the students become。

qs.s: Only by reading every day ______ improve your English.
qs.ex: only by + V-ing 在句首，後面倒裝為 can you + 原形。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: Only then I realized the mistake.
Only then did I realized the mistake.
Only then did I realize the mistake.
Only then realized I the mistake.
qs.ex: only then 在句首，後面用 did + 主詞 + 原形，故為 did I realize。其他選項未倒裝，或助動詞後誤用過去式。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: Only when it is quiet I can study well.
Only when it is quiet can study I well.
Only when is it quiet can I study well.
Only when it is quiet can I study well.
qs.ex: only when 子句本身不倒裝，主要子句才倒裝為 can I study。其他選項未倒裝，或誤倒裝子句。

title: must have p.p.（對過去的肯定推測）
formula: S + must have + p.p.
points: must have + p.p. 表示對過去事實的肯定推測，意思是「一定已經…、想必當時…」。
推測的把握很高，通常根據眼前的證據或線索。
否定推測用 can't have + p.p.，表示「不可能已經…」。
與 should have + p.p.（早該做而沒做）意思不同，要依句意區分。

examples.en: The floor is wet, so it must have rained last night.
examples.zh: 地板是濕的，所以昨晚一定下過雨。

examples.en: Kevin looks exhausted. He must have stayed up late.
examples.zh: 凱文看起來很累，他一定熬夜了。

examples.en: The cake is gone. My brother must have eaten it.
examples.zh: 蛋糕不見了，一定是我弟弟吃掉了。

tip: must have p.p. 是推測，不是責備。「早該做卻沒做」要用 should have p.p.；「不可能已經」用 can't have p.p.，不用 mustn't have。

qs.s: The lights are off, so everyone ______ home already.
qs.ex: 根據線索推測過去已經發生的事，用 must have + p.p.，故選 must have gone。

qs.s: Jenny didn't answer the phone. She ______ asleep.
qs.ex: 對過去事實的肯定推測用 must have + p.p.；fall 的過去分詞為 fallen。

qs.s: The window is broken. Someone ______ it with a ball.
qs.ex: 對過去事實的推測，用 must have + p.p.，故選 must have hit。

qs.s: Tom got full marks on the test. He ______ hard.
qs.ex: 根據他得到滿分的事實推測，用 must have + p.p.，故選 must have studied。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: The road is blocked, so there must have been an accident.
The road is blocked, so there must have an accident.
The road is blocked, so there must be had an accident.
The road is blocked, so there must been an accident.
qs.ex: 推測過去有事故用 must have been；其他選項漏掉 been 或助動詞形式錯誤。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: She must has left her wallet on the bus.
She must have left her wallet on the bus.
She must have leave her wallet on the bus.
She must have leaving her wallet on the bus.
qs.ex: must 後要接 have，再接過去分詞 left。其他選項誤用 has、原形或 V-ing。

title: 複合關係代名詞 whatever / whoever
formula: whatever / whoever / whichever + (S) + V ...
points: whatever = anything that，whoever = anyone who，whichever = 任何一個（在選定範圍內），本身同時含有先行詞和關係代名詞，所以前面不再放名詞。
這類字引導的名詞子句可以當主詞、受詞或介系詞的受詞，整個子句視為單數，後面動詞要配合。
whatever 子句裡若缺主詞或受詞，要由 whatever 本身補上，不能再多放 that 或 it。

examples.en: Whatever you decide to do after school will be fine with me.
examples.zh: 放學後你決定做什麼，我都沒意見。

examples.en: The teacher gives extra points to whoever answers the question first.
examples.zh: 老師會給最先回答問題的人加分。

examples.en: You can borrow whichever book looks interesting to you.
examples.zh: 你可以借任何一本你覺得有趣的書。

tip: whatever 已含先行詞，不可寫成 Anything whatever ... 或 whatever that ...。誤：Whatever that he says is true. → 正：Whatever he says is true.

qs.s: ______ wants to join the hiking club should sign up before Friday.
qs.ex: 空格後缺主詞，指人且作 wants 的主詞，用 Whoever。Whatever 指事物，不合。

qs.s: The cafeteria lets us eat ______ we like, as long as we finish it.
qs.ex: eat 的受詞為「任何我們喜歡的東西」，用 whatever 即可，不能再加 what that 或 anything what。

qs.s: You may take ______ seat is empty; no one has reserved any of them.
qs.ex: 後接名詞 seat，表示「任何一個」，用 whichever + 名詞；whoever 指人，不能修飾 seat。

qs.s: Our class will give a small gift to ______ gets the highest score in the contest.
qs.ex: gets 前缺主詞，雖然前面有介系詞 to，仍由子句內的角色決定，主詞用 whoever，而非 whomever。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: Whatever that my sister cooks tastes delicious.
Whatever my sister cooks tastes delicious.
Anything whatever my sister cooks tastes delicious.
Whatever my sister cooks taste delicious.
qs.ex: whatever 已含先行詞與關代，不可再加 that，也不可前面再放 anything；整個子句為單數，動詞用 tastes。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: Whoever are late for class must tell the teacher why.
Whoever is late for class must to tell the teacher why.
Whoever is late for class must tell the teacher why.
Whomever is late for class must tell the teacher why.
qs.ex: Whoever 子句視為單數，用 is；must 後接原形動詞，不加 to；late 前缺主詞，應用 whoever 而非 whomever。

title: for fear that 以免、唯恐
formula: S + V + for fear that + S + would / should / might + V原形
points: for fear that 意思是「以免、唯恐」，表示做某件事是因為擔心另一件壞事發生，語氣較正式。
that 子句要用 would、should 或 might 加原形動詞，不用 will 或 can；that 有時可省略。
for fear that 本身已有否定意味，子句中不可再加 not，如 for fear that he would not be late 是錯的。
相近用法：lest + S + (should) + V原形 意思相同；so that ... not ... 也能表示「以免」，但 so that 子句要用 won't / wouldn't 等否定形式。

examples.en: I whispered for fear that I should wake my roommate.
examples.zh: 我輕聲說話，以免吵醒室友。
hl: for fear that I should wake

examples.en: She kept her phone on silent for fear that it would ring during the test.
examples.zh: 她把手機調成靜音，唯恐考試時響起來。
hl: for fear that it would ring

examples.en: The boys walked slowly for fear that the ice might break.
examples.zh: 男孩們慢慢走，生怕冰面破裂。
hl: for fear that the ice might break

tip: for fear that 後不可再加 not，也不用 will。誤：Run for fear that you will not miss the bus. → 正：Run for fear that you might miss the bus.

qs.s: He locked the bike for fear that someone ______ it.
qs.ex: for fear that 後接 would / should / might + 原形，would steal 正確；will 與單純現在式 steals 不合。

qs.s: We stayed quiet for fear that the baby ______ up.
qs.ex: for fear that 子句用 might + 原形，might wake 正確；其他選項沒有助動詞，或多出否定。

qs.s: She took notes carefully for fear that she ______ the homework.
qs.ex: for fear that 本身含否定意味，用 would forget，不再加 not，也不用 will。

qs.s: Mike didn't tell the news to Amy ______ she should be worried.
qs.ex: 後面接完整子句 she should be worried，連接詞用 for fear that；in fear of 後面要接名詞或動名詞。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: I left early for fear that I would miss the train.
I left early for fear that I will miss the train.
I left early for fear that I would not miss the train.
I left early for fear that I missing the train.
qs.ex: for fear that 後接 would + 原形；will 不合，加 not 會變成相反的意思，missing 不是完整動詞形式。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: She spoke softly for fear that the teacher can hear her.
She spoke softly for fear that the teacher hears her.
She spoke softly for fear that the teacher might hear her.
She spoke softly for fear the teacher to hear her.
qs.ex: for fear that 之後要用 would / should / might + 原形，might hear 正確；can hear、hears 與 to hear 都不合。

title: 倍數比較句型
formula: 倍數 + the + 名詞(size/length/amount...) + of + N；倍數 + as + adj + as
points: 表示「是…的幾倍」可用「倍數 + the + 名詞 + of …」，如 twice the size of、three times the length of。
也可用「倍數 + as + 原級形容詞 + as」，如 twice as large as，兩種說法意思相近。
兩倍用 twice（或 two times），三倍以上用 three times, four times；「一半」用 half the ... of。
the 後面要接 size、height、price、number 等表示「量」的名詞，不能直接接形容詞。

examples.en: This room is twice the size of my old one.
examples.zh: 這個房間是我舊房間的兩倍大。

examples.en: The new bridge is three times as long as the old one.
examples.zh: 新橋是舊橋的三倍長。

examples.en: The ticket costs half the price of a movie ticket.
examples.zh: 這張票的價格是電影票的一半。

tip: 倍數放在 the 或 as 的前面，且 the 後要接名詞。誤：It is twice the large of mine. → 正：It is twice the size of mine.

qs.s: The school library is three times ______ the classroom.
qs.ex: 倍數 + the + 名詞 + of，three times the size of 正確；其他選項結構錯誤。

qs.s: My backpack is only half ______ my brother's, so it is much lighter.
qs.ex: half the weight of 表「是…重量的一半」，the 不可省略。

qs.s: This lake is twice as ______ as that pond.
qs.ex: as ... as 之間用形容詞或副詞原級，用 deep。

qs.s: Tom's phone cost four times ______ mine.
qs.ex: four times as much as 表「是…的四倍價錢」；as much as 用來比較金額，其他選項結構錯誤。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: The tower is two times the height than that tree.
The tower is two times height of that tree.
The tower is two times higher the height of that tree.
The tower is two times the height of that tree.
qs.ex: 正確結構為倍數 + the + height + of；其餘選項多了 than、漏 the，或重複使用比較級。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: Our new gym is five times as large as the old one.
Our new gym is five times as larger as the old one.
Our new gym is as five times large as the old one.
Our new gym is five times so large as the old one.
qs.ex: 倍數放在第一個 as 之前，as 之間用原級；larger 是比較級，as five times 位置顛倒，so 不可取代 as。

title: 複合形容詞
formula: 名詞/形容詞/副詞 + 現在分詞或過去分詞；數字 + 單數名詞
points: 複合形容詞是用連字號把兩個以上的字連成一個形容詞，放在名詞前面修飾，例如 a good-looking boy、a well-known singer。
常見組合有：副詞 + p.p.（well-known）、名詞 + V-ing（time-saving）、形容詞 + 名詞-ed（kind-hearted）。
「數字 + 單數名詞」也能構成複合形容詞，如 a ten-minute walk，名詞要用單數，不加 s。

examples.en: My uncle bought a brand-new bike for me.
examples.zh: 我叔叔買了一輛全新的腳踏車給我。

examples.en: We took a five-minute break between the two classes.
examples.zh: 兩堂課之間我們休息了五分鐘。

examples.en: She is a hard-working student who never gives up.
examples.zh: 她是個用功的學生，從不放棄。

tip: 數字構成的複合形容詞，名詞不可加 s。誤：a three-days trip → 正：a three-day trip。

qs.s: We stayed at a ______ hotel near the beach.
qs.ex: 數字 + 單數名詞作形容詞，連字號相連，star 不加 s。

qs.s: Mr. Lin is a ______ teacher, so every student likes him.
qs.ex: 形容詞 + 名詞-ed 構成複合形容詞 kind-hearted，意思為「好心腸的」，要用連字號。

qs.s: It took us a ______ ride to get to the museum.
qs.ex: two-hour ride 是常見的複合形容詞，hour 用單數。

qs.s: The park is full of ______ flowers in spring.
qs.ex: 花會散發香味，表主動，用現在分詞 smelling，構成 sweet-smelling。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: He is a well-knowing writer in our town.
He is a well-known writer in our town.
He is a known-well writer in our town.
He is a well-known-ly writer in our town.
qs.ex: 「著名的」用 well-known（副詞 + 過去分詞），其他組合不是正確的英文複合形容詞。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: She gave me a three-pages letter.
She gave me a three pages letter.
She gave me a pages-three letter.
She gave me a three-page letter.
qs.ex: 數字 + 單數名詞構成複合形容詞，且要加連字號，page 不加 s。

title: as if 引導的假設語氣
formula: as if + S + 過去式 / were（與現在事實相反）；as if + S + had + p.p.（與過去事實相反）
points: as if（= as though）表示「彷彿、好像」，子句內容與事實不符時，用假設語氣。
與現在事實相反：as if + S + 過去式，be 動詞一律用 were，如 as if he were a king。
與過去事實相反：as if + S + had + p.p.，如 as if she had seen a ghost。
若所說的內容可能是真的，也可以用直說法，如 It looks as if it is going to rain。

examples.en: He talks as if he were the boss of the club.
examples.zh: 他說話的樣子彷彿他是社團的老闆。

examples.en: She smiled as if nothing had happened.
examples.zh: 她笑得好像什麼事都沒發生過。

examples.en: The little boy ate as though he had not eaten for days.
examples.zh: 那個小男孩吃東西的樣子，彷彿好幾天沒吃飯了。
hl: as though he had not eaten

tip: as if 表示與現在事實相反時，be 動詞用 were，不用 is。誤：He acts as if he is a child.（他其實不是小孩）→ 正：He acts as if he were a child.

qs.s: Tina acts as if she ______ everything about the new teacher, but she has never met him.
qs.ex: 與現在事實相反，as if 後用過去式 knew。

qs.s: The kids looked at me as if they ______ the answer, but they didn't.
qs.ex: but they didn't 說明與當時事實相反，as if 子句用過去式 knew 表示「彷彿知道」。

qs.s: He looks at me as if I ______ a stranger, though we have been friends for years.
qs.ex: 與現在事實相反，as if 子句中的 be 動詞用 were。

qs.s: The room was a mess, as if a storm ______ through it last night.
qs.ex: 表示與過去事實相反，用 had + p.p.；had passed 正確。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: She treats me as if I am being her little sister.
She treats me as if I being her little sister.
She treats me as if I were her little sister.
She treats me as if I be her little sister.
qs.ex: 與現在事實相反（我不是她妹妹），as if 子句的 be 動詞用 were。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: He spoke as if he has seen the movie, but he hadn't.
He spoke as if he had seen the movie, but he hadn't.
He spoke as if he will see the movie, but he hadn't.
He spoke as if he sees the movie, but he hadn't.
qs.ex: 說話者其實沒看過，與過去事實相反，as if 後用 had seen。

title: 省略 if 的倒裝假設句（過去式）
formula: Had + S + p.p., S + would/could/might + have + p.p.
points: 與過去事實相反的假設句 If + S + had + p.p., S + would have + p.p. 可以省略 if，把 had 移到句首，成為 Had + S + p.p.。
倒裝只適用於 had、were、should 開頭的假設句，語氣較正式，常用在書面英文。
否定時 not 放在主詞後，如 Had he not left early, ...，不可寫成 Hadn't he left ...。
主要子句仍維持 would / could / might + have + p.p.。

examples.en: Had I studied harder, I would have passed the test.
examples.zh: 如果我當時更用功讀書，就會通過那次考試。

examples.en: Had we left earlier, we could have caught the train.
examples.zh: 如果我們早點出發，就趕得上那班火車了。

examples.en: Had she not helped us, we might have lost our way.
examples.zh: 如果她當時沒幫我們，我們可能會迷路。

tip: 倒裝後不可再保留 if，否定時也不用縮寫。誤：If had I known, ... / Hadn't I known, ... → 正：Had I known, ...

qs.s: ______ the bus been on time, we wouldn't have been late for school.
qs.ex: 省略 if 的過去假設倒裝，把 had 移到句首，Had the bus been ...。

qs.s: Had Peter ______ the invitation, he would have come to the party.
qs.ex: Had + S + p.p. 的結構，空格需過去分詞 received。

qs.s: ______ I known about the rain, I would have brought an umbrella.
qs.ex: 後面是 would have brought，表示與過去事實相反，倒裝開頭用 Had。

qs.s: Had they not fixed the road, the trip ______ much more difficult.
qs.ex: 與過去事實相反，主要子句用 would have + p.p.，would have been 正確。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: Had I known his number, I would have called him.
If had I known his number, I would have called him.
Did I know his number, I would have called him.
Have I known his number, I would have called him.
qs.ex: 省略 if 時，倒裝為 Had + S + p.p.，且不可保留 if。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: Hadn't the teacher helped me, I would have failed.
Had the teacher not helped me, I would have failed.
Had not the teacher helped, I will fail.
Had the teacher not help me, I would have failed.
qs.ex: 否定句要寫成 Had + S + not + p.p.，不用 Hadn't 倒裝；動詞也要用過去分詞 helped，主要子句用 would have failed。
